tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs so// dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /btud de rdo rje 'byung ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i ngag 'don rnams/ /rgyas bsdus gsal bar rjod par byed/ /de la sngon du bya ba'i rim pa thams cad legs par tshar nas/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis rang rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur/ kha lag bkru/ sa ma ya stoṃ gyis stan la 'dug par bya ste/ sa skya pa ltar na sngon 'gro'i gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba las/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ lha rdzas las grub pa mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skye bar gyur/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ ā d+ya nud pan na twata bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ sar+b+ba tad khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ ā d+ya nud pan na twad/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha kun dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sems can kun la dge don du/ /byams pa'i sems kyis gnas par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ lan gsum dang / badz+ra satwa/ sa byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ yig brgya lan bdun brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin brlab ste bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin las/ hūm̐/ tsan dan chu la bden pa bdar ba yis/ /phyogs gsum gtor bas yongs su dag gyur te/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur nas/ /dri med 'dod yon dag dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ye swā hā/ yang badz+ra satwa dang / puṣ+pe sogs sngar bzhin rol mo yang dbul/

de nas bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la/ chos la/ dge 'dun la'o/ /'gro rnams sgrol 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi'o/ /swa bhā wa sngar bzhin dang / stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum bsgreng ba'i dbus ma'i rtse mo la dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rang gi thugs kar bstod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis dril bu kha nang du bstan nas bsnyems pa'i tshul gyis dkur brten par gyur pa'i lkog mar hriḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lce'i thad ka'i 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de lce la thim pas lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dz+ri hwā/ lag pa gnyis su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po/ de zhu ba las rdo rje'i lag pa sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ du gyur/ hūm̐ gi sgras/ gdug pa can thams cad btul/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub brtan par mdzad/ rdo rje'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa las/

khro bo rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog sngo ba zhal khro ba dang bcas pas bzhad pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur khro bo'i dril bu dang bcas pas bsnyems pa'i tshul gyis 'chang ba/ g.yas pas khro bo'i rdo rje blangs te dregs pas gsor ba la brtson pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba can 'od zer 'bar ba kun tu 'khrugs pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i rdo rje phreng ba'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas shing khro bo'i rdo rje blta bas gzigs pa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ baṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lā rka hūm̐/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ lan bzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ri ṇī hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ dharma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ karma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ lan lnga dang / oṃ ṭuṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis sngar bzhin mchod nas/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/

/ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom/ /khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur par gdon mi za/ /zhes brjod la rol mo bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐/ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañca ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ne tri ban dha sar+b+ba bigh+naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍ+ḍho me bha wa rak+ṣa sar+b+baṃ swā hā/ oṃ hū lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ druṃ ban+dha haṃ/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pā sha hṝḥ oṃ badz+ra pā ta ke pa taṃ gi ni raṭa/ hrīḥbadz+ra kā li ruṭa ma ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ruṭa ma ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra karma/ hūm̐ badz+ra ban+dha baṃ/ srung 'khor ro/ /yang mchod pa bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin bya/ rang rdo rje rgyur gyur pa'i thugs ka nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul te/

srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs su bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du zhugs par gyur/ mchod yon sogs kyis mchod pa sngar bzhin bya/ /thub pa kun gyi nyi ma yi/ /mgon po chen por rab btud nas/ /phyogs rnams kun sngags 'di yin te/ /phyag ni rab tu btsal bar bya/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta pra ṇā me na badz+ra ban+da nāṃ ka ro mi/ shes rab chen po sangs rgyas kun/ /yang nas yang du dran byas te/ /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas kun/ /rdo rje rigs kyis bskul bar bya/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+d+ya nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ rdo rje'i gsang sngags 'di yis ni/ /lho phyogs su ni phyag byas te/ /sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad la/ /bdag ni dbul bar bya ba yin/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ dam chos thams cad slob dpon zhes/ /nub phyogs su ni phyag byas te/ /rdo rje'i sngags 'dis bskul bya zhing / /bdag nyid rab tu dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhar+m+ma pra bar+t+ta ya māṃ/ mchod dang dbang bskur chos ldan zhing / /byang du las la nges sbyor bas/ /byang phyogs su ni phyag byas te/ /bdag nyid rdo rje las su gyur/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza kar+m+ma ṇe āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kar+m+ma ku ru māṃ/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan snga dang /

de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs su zhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha thams cad kyi spyan sngar/ sdig pa thams cad bla na med pa'i so sor bshags pas so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams dang / sems can thams cad kyi tshogs kyi tsho bsod nams thams cad la rgya cher rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya ba'i phyir bskul bar bya'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal lo/ /gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na lha dang mi rnams kyi me tog gi bye brag yid las byung ba'am/ chu las skyes pa'am thang las skyes pa gang yod pa de rnams 'di lta ste/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs lnga dang bcas par bzhugs pa thams cad dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi lha'i khyad par thams cad la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /gnas 'di'am ni gzhan dag na/ /lha sogs bdag gir ma byas pa'i/ /me tog chu skyes thang skyes rnams/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pa pu dza me gha sa mu dra smra ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ gang yang nas lha dang mi rnams kyi zhes pa'i bar gos dang dpag bsam gyi shing 'bul ba'i bar kun gyi mgo dang gang dag nas 'bul bar bgyi'o zhes pa'i bar 'di dpag bsam gyi shing 'bul ba'i bar kun gyi mjug tu sbyor/

'dug pa'i bye brag lhan cig skyes pa'am/ yang dag par sbyar ba'am yongs su gyur pa can/ gnas 'di'am ni gzhan dag na/ /gang dag spos kyi shing bzang po/ /lha yi spos sogs rmad byung ba/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta dhū paṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra sma ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ snang ba'i bye brag yid las byung ba'am/ rin po che'i 'od dam mar me'i snang ba la sogs pa gang dag sogs sngar bzhin no/ /rin chen bzang po cher 'bar dang / /snang ba'i shing las byung ba dang / /nyi ma zla ba la sogs 'od/ /phyogs rnams kun tu spros te dbul/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta zhes pa gsang mchod kyi bar kun gyi mgor sbyar/ ā lo ke zhes pa go brje/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra sma ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas gsang mchod kyi bar kun gyi mjug tu sbyar ro/ /dri'i bye brag lhan cig skyes pa'am/ yang dag par sbyar ba'am yongs su gyur pa can/ gnas 'di'am ni gzhan dag na/ /dri yi shing rnams bzang po'i chab/ /phyogs rnams kun tu spros pa yis/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnams la 'bul/ /gan+dha/ rin po che'i ri bo'am rgya mtsho'i rin po che'i tshogs/ rin chen rang bzhin rgya mtsho dang / /rin chen ri bo la sogs mchog /mchod pa'i sprin ni spros pa yis/ /phyogs rnams kun tu dbul bar bya/ /bo dh+yaṃ ga rat+na a laṃ kā ra/ rgod pa dang / sgeg pa dang / dga' ba dang / rtsed 'jo'i bde ba'i bye brag rtsed 'jo'i bde ba dga' chen po/ /rgod dang sgeg la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /phyogs rnams kun tu thams cad nas/ /dga' ba'i mchog 'di spro bar bya/ /hā s+ya lā s+ya ra ti kri ṭa sau khya a nut+ta ra/ dpag bsam gyi shing ngam gos kyi shing gang dag sogs sngar bzhin no/ /gos dang rgyan sogs 'byung ba yi/ /de bzhin dpag bsam shing bzang po/ /rdo rje sngags ni brjod bya zhing / /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /a nut+ta ra bo dhi a lam kā ra wasatra/

ma rgal ba rnams bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir dang / ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / dbugs ma phyung pa rnams dbyugs dbyung bar bya ba'i phyir dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus pa rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las yang dag par bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /phyogs rnams kun tu spro byas te/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /badz+ra bo dhi tsit+ta/ sems can thams cad yo byad thams cad kyis yang dag par 'byor zhing phun sum tshogs thams cad 'dod pa tsam la rag lus par gyur cig sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin mchod pas/ /sems dpa' thams cad dpal dang ni/ /nor dang ldan pa 'grub par shog /bde ba ma tshang med par shog /ma hā badz+rod bha wa dā na pā ra mi tā/ sems can thams cad mi dge ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par bral bar gyur cig dge ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi mtha' thams cad dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad byang chub dang / /sdom la rab tu gnas par shog /rgyags sogs nyes pa chen po rnams/ /zhi gyur kun tu spro bar bya/ /a nut+ta ra ma hā bo dh+ya hā ra shī la pā ra mi tā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad kyis lus la yang dag par brgyan par byas pa dang / rtag tu phan tshun 'jigs pa med pa dang / zhe 'gras pa med par zhugs shing mig dang / yid mngon par dga' ba dang / chos zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan par gyur cig 'jigs dang 'khon sogs sdug bsngal la/ /sogs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /byams dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /chos la bdag med bsgrub par bya/ /a nut+ta ra ma hā dhar+m+ma a ba bo dhi k+ṣan+ti pā ra mi tā/ sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa dang ldan pa dang /

sangs rgyas nyid du yongs su gzhol zhing 'khor ba yongs su mi spong pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan par gyur cig 'khor ba mthar thug bar du ni/ /bdag 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /de bzhin sems can thams cad ni/ /de nyid sgrub par byed par shog /san sā ra a pa ri t+yā ga a nut+ta ra ma hā bī r+ya pā ra mi tā/ sems can nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang bral bar gyur cig bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang rig pa thams cad mngon du gyur pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig srog chags kun gyi 'dod chags sogs/ /nyon mongs chen po zhi bar shog /sems can thams cad g.yeng med cing / /bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan par shog /a nut+ta ra sau khya bi hā ra dh+yā na pā ra mi tā/ sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab dang ye shes rnams dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob ste/ bzod dang bstan bcos thams cad shes shing sgyu rtsal dang ldan la gsang ba'i cho ga shes pa dang / de kho na nyid mthong ste nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad yang dag par gcod pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig sangs rgyas ye shes shes rab che/ /sdug bsngal gcod byed bla na med/ /shes rab sbyor bas dag byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sems can dag gyur cig /a nut+ta ra kle sha ts+tshe da sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥs man tā dz+nyā na ma hā pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ stong gsum gyi ni rdul snyed du/ /bdag nyid kyang ni rnam bsam zhing / /mchod pa'i phyir ni rnam bsams nas/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /kā ya nir+yā ta na/ stong gsum gyi ni rdul snyed kyi/ /bdag nyid kyang ni rnam bsam zhing / /lce ni de snyed ldan dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa brjod par bya/ /mnyam med mi g.yo mnyam med mchog gi chos nyid can/

/thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam med dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas mnyam med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur yang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phangs mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pa/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgyas pa ste/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /wāk+ka nir+yā ta na/ de nas rnal 'byor de nyid kyis/ /lus dang ngag sems byung ba yi/ /mchod pa dag ni bsdus nas su/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya/ /tsit+ta nir+yā ta na/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med cing / /stong nyid mtshan ma kun dang bral/ /smon pa med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya pū dza me gha sa mu dra sma ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag nyid 'bul gyis/ bdag dus thams cad dang rnam pa thams cad du so sor bzhes su gsol/

thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i mgon po khyed rnams kyis dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub bdag la bstsal du gsol/ /ma lus phyogs bzhugs mchog gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'di ltar nye bar zhi ba bdag /ci nas rdo rje nyid gyur mdzod/ /rdo rje rigs kyi mchog gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad la/ /rtag tu rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag nyid dag ni dbul bar bgyi/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang yang dag par ldan pa'i bde ba nyid dang yid bde ba nyid kyis mi'i mchog sangs rgyas su tshe 'di nyid la gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/

/pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par bgyi/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi/ /ma rgal ba ni bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhes/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgos/ /tshogs bsag pa'o/ /āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ hūm̐ a/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ a ā/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ oṃ aḥ oṃ hūm̐/ traṃ hriḥ.āḥrnam snang / mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje kun ma rnams a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥ pa raspa ra/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥ badz+ra añja li/ a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sar+b+ba r+m+maḥ badz+ra ban+dha/ badz+ra ban+dha trāṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ.aḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ shā shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sar+b+ba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba a pā ya ā kar+ṣa ṇa bi shwa dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di la bskyab tu gsol/ bdag cag rnams sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun dang / khyed la skyabs su mchi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bis+pho ṭa ya/ sar+b+ba a pā ya/ ban+dha nā ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sar+b+ba a pā ya/ ga te bh+yaḥ sar+b+ba satwān sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya trāta/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra dharma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra karma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra badz+raṃ ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇ-i hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ dhar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ karma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rā dza dza/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra sā dhū sa/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rat+na oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra te dza aṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ke tu traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣa dhaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ka r+m+ma kaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra san dhi baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra mu lā s+ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hīḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ puṣ+pe trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrī/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra gan dhe aḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha āḥ oṃ badz+ra muḥ phyag rgya bcings pa spyi'i cho ga'o/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la thim nas/ lha thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang skad cig gis rdor sems su gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje'i dbus su badz+ra satwa/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i phyogs su rang gi sems nyid badz+ra satwa/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥbacu drug gi rnam pa de zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du badz+ra satwa/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha a laṃ k+ṣaḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa/ zla ba gnyis pa de badz+ra satwa dang bcas pa las dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rdo rje 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang bcas pa de'i lte bar badz+ra satwas mtshan pa/ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra satwa lan gsum dang / rdo rje de las rdor sems kyis gtso byas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lha dpag tu med pa sprul/ des sems can gyi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lhar byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i dbyings thams cad rdo rje der zhugs pas/ rdo rje de rang gi rigs kyi lha thams cad kyi rdul phra rab 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ bdag ni sems dpa' kun bdag grags/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bdag la gnas/ /badz+ra satwa zla ba rdo rje de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ oṃ ma hā sa ma ya satwa haṃ sa ma yo haṃ/ sa ma ya satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa mā/ lan bzhi/ badz+ra satwa lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ lan gsum/ rang gzhi lus pas tha dad du bye/ gzhi lus kyi snying gar zhugs/ stong gsum pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi tshad tsam gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ lan gsum dang / mdun gyi nam mkha' dbyings su rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul/ rang rdor sems su gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa swa mi māṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho nas hoḥ'i bar dang / badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/

oṃ badz+ra dhā tī shwa ri hūm̐/ badz+ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ dharma badz+ri hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ karma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ ṭuṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra nā ma ya bhi ṣe ka taḥ kye rdo rje dbyings kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad yin/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lags na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma yi tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twāṃ dhā ra yā mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ snying ga'i bdag 'jug go /mdun gyi dkyil 'khor snying gar thim sa ma ya aḥ lha'i gnas nyer brgyad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sngar bzhin brjod la bskyed/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra satwa aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ su ra tasatwaṃ badz+ra satwa dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma yasatwaṃ a haṃ/ badz+ra satwa lan gsum mo/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ lan gsum mo/ /snying ga'i g.yas su rdo rje rgyal lo/ /gser mdog phyag gnyis lcags kyus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rā dza aḥ aṃ ku sho haṃ/ badz+ra rā dzo haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha sogs nas/ a haṃ gi bar sngar bzhin no/ /badz+ra rā dza/ oṃ badz+ra ru dza dza/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /snying ga'i g.yon du chags pa dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mda' ut+pal dmar po kha ma bye ba'i mde'u can/

rdo rje'i gzhu rna ba'i bar du bkang nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la 'bigs par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya dzaḥ badz+ra rā ga aḥ sha ro haṃ/ badz+ra rā go haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra rā ga oṃ badz+ra rā ga hoḥ lan gsum gsum mo/ /rgyab tu rdo rje legs pa ljang gu dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis bsnams nas legs so sbyin pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra sā dhu aḥ tuṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ sarba sā dhu ra haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra sā dhu oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa/ lan gsum mo/ /dpral bar rin chen ser po phyag g.yas rdo rjes rin po che rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'jog cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rat+na aḥ rat+na ma haṃ/ badz+ra gar bho haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra rat+na/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na oṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /ltag par gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdog can phyag g.yas kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa yod pa'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang bar mdzad pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra te dza aḥ badz+ra aḥ badz+ra sur+yo haṃ/ badz+ra pra bho haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra te dz+ra/ oṃ badz+ra te dz+ra aṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /phrag pa gnyis su rgyal mtshan sngon po phyag g.yas pas dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog can gyi rgyal mtshan phrag pa'i phyogs su bsgreng ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa la nges par sbyor bar mdzad cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra ke tu aḥ ke tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra yaṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra ke tu/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu trāṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /so'i phreng ba gnyis su bzhad pa dkar po phyag g.yas pas dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis kyi dbus su chud pa'i so'i phreng ba kha 'gram g.yas su 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dzum pa rmad du byung ba la nges par sbyor zhing /

g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra ha sa aḥ smi ta ma haṃ/ badz+ra prī ti ra haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin no/ /badz+ra hā sa/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /lkog mar rdo rje chos dkar dmar phyag g.yon pas rdo rje pad+ma'i sdong bu dkur brten zhing / g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis snying gar rdo rje pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra dhar+m+ma a/ pad+mo haṃ/ badz+ra ne tro haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hrīḥ lan gsum gsum bya/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar du rdo rje rnon po sngon po phyag g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis thugs kar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams shing / g.yas pa rdo rje ral gris de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'debs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra tīk+ṣa aḥ khaḍ+go haṃ/ badz+ra bud+dhi ra haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhaṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /lte bar rgyu gser gyi mdog can phyag g.yas pa'i gung mo'i rtse mo na dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rtsibs can gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor ba'i tshul du 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra he tu a/ tsakra ma haṃ/ badz+ra maṇ+ṭo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra he tu/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ lan gsum gsum mo/ /lce la smra ba zangs kyi mdog can phyag g.yas pas dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lce bsnams nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la smra bar mdzad cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra bhā ṣa aḥdzi hwā haṃ/ badz+ra bā tso haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra bhā ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /spyi bor rdo rje las rab zhal dang byin pa gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar dkar po/ zhal gyi 'og nas rked pa'i bar dmar skya/ rked pa'i bar dang phyag gnyis sngo skya/

brla gnyis ser skya/ lhag ma sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra karma aḥ karma badz+ra bi shwo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin no/ /badz+ra karma/ oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /nam tshoms su bsrung ba gser gyi mdog can/ phyag gnyis kyis mtha' gnyis su rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i rdo rje'i go cha bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la go bsgom pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa aḥ war mo haṃ/ badz+ra bīr+yo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ lan gsum brjod/ khar rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po lto ba yangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsdigs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra yak+ṣa aḥdaṃṣ+ṭ+ri ra haṃ/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ dku gnyis su khu tshur ser po dam tshig gi rdo rje khu tshur gyis dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'tshir ba'i tshul du mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra san dhi aḥ muṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra san dhi/ oṃ badz+ra san dhi baṃ lan gsum gsum brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa'i g.yon du sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis bsnyems pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing g.yon du mgo cung zad 'dud pa'o/ /sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra lā s+ye aḥ badz+ra dwa ya ma haṃ/ badz+ra lā s+ya haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra lā s+ya/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ rdo rje rin chen gyi g.yon du phreng ba ma ser mo/ phyag gnyis rdo rje rin po che'i phreng bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dbang bskur bar mdzad pa/

sa ma ya āḥ badz+ra mā le aḥ rat+na mā lā haṃ/ badz+ra mā lā haṃ/ aṅku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra mā le/ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /rdo rje chos kyi g.yon du glu ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pi wang brdung pa la brtson pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra gī ti aḥ bī ṇā haṃ/ badz+ra gī t+ya haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra gī ti/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hriḥ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /rdo rje las kyi g.yon du gar ma sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin phyag gnyis rdo rjes rtse gsum pa gnyis bsnams nas gar byed pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥbadz+ra nṛ t+ya ka ra pal+la bo haṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra nṛ t+ye/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /gsang gnas su bdug pa ma dkar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i spos snod bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams tshim par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra dhū pe aḥ dhū po haṃ/ badz+ra dhū pā haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra dhū pe/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /mgo bor me tog ma ser mo phyag g.yon rdo rje me tog gi snod 'dzin zhing / g.yas me tog gi char 'bebs par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe aḥ puṣ+pa ma haṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pa haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tre/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ mig gnyis su mar me ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rje mar me'i sdong bu bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams snang ba'i tshogs kyis mchod par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra ā lo ke aḥ dī po haṃ/ badz+ra dī pā haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /nu ma dang brang dang snying gar byug pa ma sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin/ phyag g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dri'i dung phor bsnams te phyag g.yas dri'i sprin gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa mchod par mdzad pa/

sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra gan dhe aḥ gan dhe haṃ/ badz+ra gan dhā haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra gan dhe/ oṃ badz+ra gan dhe aḥ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /brla g.yas su lcags kyu dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyu bsnams nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra aṃ ku sha aḥ aṃ ku sho haṃ/ badz+ra aṃ ku she haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /brla g.yon du zhags pa ser po phyag gnyis rdo rje zhags pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jug par mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra pā sha aḥ pā sho haṃ/ badz+ra pā sho haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra pā sha/ oṃ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /byin pa g.yas su lcags sgrog dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags sgrog gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'ching bar mdzad pa/ sa ma ya aḥ badz+ra s+pho ṭa aḥs+pho ṭo haṃ/ badz+ra s+pho ṭo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ byin pa g.yon du 'bebs pa sna tshogs mdog can sngar bzhin phyag g.yas pa rdo rje dril bu bsnams te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'bebs par mdzad pa/ g.yon gdan la brtan pa/ sa ma ya aḥbadz+ra ā be sha aḥghan ṭo haṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭo haṃ/ aṃ ku sha sogs sngar bzhin/ badz+ra ā be sha oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ 'og ma gnyis lan gsum gsum brjod/ bsgrub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa thams cad gzhi lus dang brten pa nyer brgyad dang bcas pa la bye ma la bum chu blugs pa bzhin du dbyer med du thim par gyur/ bsgrub chen no/ /sa ma ya staṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ badz+ra dhā tu dṛ sh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya satwaṃ a haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī shwa ri hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ sa ma ya nas dhu tu'i bar sngar bzhin 'og ma bzhi la'ang 'gre'o/

/oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma hūm̐/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ las dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa dam rgya'o/ /yang lha thams cad kyi lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lce'i pad+ma'i 'dab mar aḥlas zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ chur nyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ rdo rje'i lte ba la rang rang gi chos kyi yi ge badz+ra dz+nyā na lnga dang / sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ā na ya swa/ a ho su kha/ su dhū sā dhū/ su ma ha satwaṃ/ ru po d+yo ta/ ar+b+ba prapa tiḥ ha ha hūm̐ he/ sar+b+ba kā ri/ duḥkha ts+tsha da/ bud+dha bo dhi/ pra ti shabha/ su ba shisatwaṃ/ nir bha ya staṃ/ sha trun bhak+ṣa/ sar+b+ba sid+dhi/ ma hā ra tiḥ rū pa sho bhe/ sho tra sau khya/ sarba pu dze/ pra h+la da ni/ pha lā ga me/ su te dzā gri/ su gan dhāṃ gi/ ā yā hi dzaḥ ā ya hi hūm̐/ he s+pho ṭa baṃ/ ghaṇ+ṭa āḥ.āḥrnams kyis mtshan pa chos rgya'o/ /lha thams cad kyi snying gar zla ba la a las sna tshogs rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu/ lnga dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra rā dza/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga oṃ badz+ra sā dhū/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na/ oṃ badz+ra te dza/ oṃ badz+ra ke tu/ oṃ badz+ra hā pa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa/ oṃ badz+ra he tu/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra karma/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ oṃ badz+ra san dhi/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye/ oṃ badz+ra mā le/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti/ oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke/ oṃ badz+ra gan dhe/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha las rgya'o/ /lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ badz+ra dhā tu nas/ ā be sha'i bar oṃ med pa sngar bzhin te/ phyag chen no/ /satwa badz+ri ṇi a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ lan lnga/ rat+na badz+ri a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ dhar+m+ma badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/

kar+m+ma badz+ri a dhi ti ṣ+ṭha swa m+maṃ/ badz+ra dha twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa mī/ lan bzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pa la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+ya me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sar+b+ba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca tri/ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐/ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñca māṃ nas/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐ gi bar sngar bzhin/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra hā ta/ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ rdo rje chos kyi glur blangs pas/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma gā ya naiḥ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma ka rod bha we/ badz+ra nṛ t+ye aḥbadz+ra dhū pe sogs la'ang sngar bzhin du spel lo/ /ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ ṭak+ki dzaḥhoḥ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa'/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /aḥlas skyes pa'i dril bu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i bdag po dam pa kun gyi mchog dbang phyug gi dam pa de nyid chos kyi mchog gi bka' yang dag par stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa'i mchog ni mdzad pa yin/ /dhar+m+ma āḥsrid pa'i bde ba shin tu myur/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/

/dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni brten bzhin du/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i theg pa chen po'i chen po dam tshig chen po'i sbyor ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi dam tshig go /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang / /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pas/ /phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ /yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro/ /oṃ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba sa mo haṃ/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'greng ba'i lte bar rang gi snying po mgo gyen du bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ ā d+ya nuta pan+na twata/ brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang las hūm̐/ yaṃ hūm̐ las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho/ de'i steng du hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ las gser gyi sa gzhi/

de'i steng du hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ las rgya mtsho chen po/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa/ rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa rak+ṣa sar+b+baṃ swā hā/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang du/ yang gzhal yas khang gru bzhi rta babs med pa/ rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che las byas pa/ dbus su ā siṃ ā las seng ge'i khri/ shar du hūm̐ ga hūm̐ las glang po che'i khri/ lhor tra bā tra las rta'i khri/ nub tu hrīḥmaṃ hriḥlas rma bya'i khri/ byang du aḥg aḥlas nam mkha' sding gi khri/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su hrīḥlas pad+ma/ gtso bo lnga'i pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba/ dbus kyi seng ge'i gdan gyi steng du phyag rgya chen po/ nam mkha' la gnas pa las babs nas sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'dug par gyur to/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gis gson pa'ang 'bras bu bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig gis mnyam pa/ /gyur par bdag ni som nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las/ /mi ldog par ni bdag 'gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /de bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /de bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa mchog yin no/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga tā kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta pra na me na badz+ra ban dha nāṃ ka ro mi/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag med 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol/ /tshigs bcad 'di gnyis kyi bar bsnyen pa rkyang pa la mi dgos/ de nas bdag nyid bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med la snyoms par zhugs so/

/de nas bsam gtan dang po la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can la/ de nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa la/ de nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la/ de nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la/ de nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la/ de nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched la/ de nas 'du shes med min gyi skye mched la/ de nas srid rtse la/ de nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched la/ de nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la/ de nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la/ de nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa la/ de nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med la/ yang bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can la/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa la/ de nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la/ de nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched la/ de nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched la/ de nas srid rtse la/ de nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la/ de nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam la/ de nas mi lcogs med pa/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam la/ de nas bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can la/ de nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa la/ de nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i chung ngu'i chung ngu la/ de nas chung ngu'i 'bring po la/ de nas chung ngu'i chen po la/ de nas 'bring pa'i chung ngu la/ de nas 'bring po'i 'bring po la/ de nas 'bring po'i chen po la/ de nas chen po'i chung ngu la/ de nas chen po'i 'bring po la/ de nas chen po'i chen po la snyoms par zhugs nas yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyi 'og min du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis nges par 'byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa'i gzugs sku mdog dkar po/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par skyes te sems dpa'i skyil mo krung la gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad dper na til gyi gang bu bzhin du yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs kyi sku dang / chos nyid rjes su dran pa dang theg pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba'i chos dang / theg pa chen po'i byang chub sems pa'i dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad dang / 'gro ba thams cad la lhag par byams pa bskyed pa dang / ngan 'gro la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdungs pa thams cad la snying brtse ba dang / 'phags pa thams cad la dga' ba dang / 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la yang btang snyoms su bya ba dang / chos thams cad la yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa nyid dang / mig yor dang mtshungs pa nyid du lhag par mos pa dang / byang chub tu sems skyed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa dang / rigs lnga dang / rdo rje dang dril bu dang / slob dpon nyid dang / byams pa dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / zang zing dang / chos kyi sbyin pa dang / sngags kyi tshul thams cad ston pa dang / theg pa gsum gyis nges par 'byung ba dang / gsang sngags kyi sgo'i spyod pa rnams mngon du byas pas slob pa'i sa phal cher mthar phyin nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dar gyi cod pan gyis dbang bskur te/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i mchog bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes mos nas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir dper na til gyi gang bu bzhin du yongs su gang bar gyur to/

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba byang chub kyi snying por 'dug pa gang na ba des gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ched du rdzogs longs spyod pa'i skur bstan nas/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes brjod cing se gol gyi sgras mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bslang ste/ 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon par ma rtogs par dka' ba spyod pa thams cad la spro ba bskyed cing / ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par bya snyam/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bskul bas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da ban dha nāṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas nas/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams de kho na nyid ji lta bu lags/ ji ltar na bsgrub par bgyi/ bka' bstsal du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi gsung gcig tu 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rang gi sems la so sor rtog cing mnyam par zhog la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dga' bar zlos shing bsgrub par gyis shig oṃ tsit+ta pra ti be dhaṃ ka ro mi/ sems stong nyid bcu drug gi rang bzhin ā li bcu drug las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i don thams cad grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag gi snying ga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur gda' ba bdag gis rtogs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' bstsal pa/

rigs kyi bu sems de ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas na de ni ji lta bur sbyangs pas de lta bur 'gyur te/ dper na ras dkar po tshon gyis bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i sems zhes pa rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ zhes bya ba rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'dis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de byang chub kyi sems bskyed pas sems kyi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bas rnam snang la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ston par byed pa'i kā li'i rang bzhin/ zla ba gnyis par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bkas byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mthong ba gang lags pa de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gzugs gnyis pa nyid du mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' bstsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po sems bskyed pa kun tu bzang po de khyod kyis mngon sum du gyur gyis de legs par sgrubs shig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems bskyed pa kun tu bzang po de brtan par bya ba'i phyir sngags 'di zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i dbyibs su soms shig oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na rdo rje bdag gis mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' bstsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi kun tu bzang po'i sems rdo rje de sngags 'dis brtan par gyis shig oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko haṃ/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du mnyam par 'jug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje dbyings ji snyed pa de dag thams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis sems dpa'i zla ba rdo rje der zhugs so/

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa de la rdo rje'i dbyings zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dbyings kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku ni bdag lags par mthong lags so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bka' bstsal pa/ sems dpa' chen po de lta bas na sems dpa'i rdo rje de rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skur bdag nyid rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dgar zlos la soms shig oṃ ya thā sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sta thā a haṃ/ de nas de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dbyings kyis bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs par mngon par sangs rgyas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas bos nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs la/ mngon par byang chub pa 'di brtan par mdzod cig de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje der zhugs so/ /oṃ badz+ra dhā twi shwa ri hūm̐/ badz+ri ṇi a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ lan bzhi dang / yig brgya brjod/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi saṃ bo dhi/ dṛ dha badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha/ skad cig ma de nyid kyi tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i dam tshig du zhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs par rang bzhin gyis dag go

/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sems dpa'i rdo rje las byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes bskyed nas nam mkha'i snying po'i nor bu rin po che'i dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ truṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ de nas kun tu sangs rgyas gzigs kyi dbang po'i chos kyi ye shes ni bskyed/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang / nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las thams cad la rab tu bzhag nas sprul bshad kyi sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir longs sku 'og min du bzhag nas/ de las sprul pa'i sku rigs lnga 'og min nas babs te/ ri rab kyi rtse mo gang na ba dang / khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa ga na ba der gshegs te byon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du/ byin gyis brlabs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi seng ge'i gdan la zhal bzhir kun tu bstan te bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa rnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du so so nas bdag nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs te glang po che la sogs pa'i khri la phyogs bzhir bzhugs so/

/dang po'i sbyor ba'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka'i zla ba rdo rje las byung ngo / /badz+ra satwa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po/ de nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang sems can thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po yang dag par sbyangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyogs phyogs su 'khod do/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de dag las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje phung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs su zhugs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi tshad dang mnyam par 'jug pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba can rtse mo lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i dbyibs su gzugs chen po gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje de las kyang rdo rje lta bu'i 'od zer gzugs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang bas khyab par byed pa rnams byung ngo / /rdo rje lta bu'i 'od zer de dag gi rtse mo las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mnyam sku byung ste/

chos kyi dbyings kun tu khyab pa thams cad dang / nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i sprin thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon par shes pa mngon par byang chub pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed pa dang / kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa sna tshogs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs mnyes par mdzad pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po chen por gshegs pa dang / bdud thams cad btul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi byang chub chen por mngon par byang chub pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / ji srid sems can gyi khams ma lus pa med pa rnams yongs su skyob cing thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dang mngon par shes pa dang dam pa'i dngos grub grub pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams kyi bar bstan nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi kun tu bzang po yin pa dang shin tu brtan pa yin pa'i phyir dang / gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i skur gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka'i rdo rje la gnas nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni rang byung ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i sems dpa' brtan/ /de ni brtan phyir lus min yang / /sems dpa'i lus su gyur pa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan snga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / sems can gyi don bya ba dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas ji srid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa rnams bla na med pa'i theg pa chen por mngon par rtogs pa grub pa'i mchog thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur ba nyid du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi grub pa'i rdo rje de de'i lag par byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lag na rdo rje lag na rdo rje zhes rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje phyag g.yon pa'i dril bu bsgyings pas bzhugs/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gsor bas nyid kyi thugs kar bstod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis grub pa yi/ /rdo rje bla na med pa 'di/ /bdag te bdag gi lag tu byin/ /rdo rje la ni rdo rje gnas/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po shin tu gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po'i dam tshig las byung ba'i sems dpa'i byin gyis brlab rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra rā dzāḥ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lcags kyu chen por gyur te byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje lcags kyu chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu'i dbyibs chen po de las 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu/ 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po shin tu gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po'i lus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /lcags kyu nges pa'i rgyal po bdag /gang phyir kun tu sangs rgyas khyab/ /grub phyir kun nas spyan 'dren no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po shin tu gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren pa'i dam tshig gi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren pa'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad 'gugs pa dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myang bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'du ba'i byin gyis brlabs dam pa'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/

rdo rje lcags kyu de byang chub sems dpa' chen po gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje 'gugs pa rdo rje 'gugs pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'gugs pas rdo rje lcags kyu des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi/ /ye shes bla na med pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /kun nas spyan drang dam pa'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'dud ces bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba'i sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra ra ga de nas de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi me tog gi mdar gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje'i mda' chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje mda'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par bya ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu bdud byed pa nyid yin pa dang / rab tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/

byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud ces bya ba'i lus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag gi rang bzhin dag /rang byung ba dag dgyes byed na/ /'dod chags bral rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'dul bar byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud de'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur te de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdud rdo rje'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad mgu bar bya ba dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdud kyi las kyi byin gyis brlabs dam pa'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje'i mda' de byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud ces bya ba de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje'i gzhu rdo rje'i gzhu zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gzhu zhes bya bas/ rdo rje mda' des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bdud byed cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'dod chags kyi/ /ye shes 'di ni dri ma med/ /'dod chags kyis ni chags bral bcom/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed/

/de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po'i dam tshig las byung ba'i sems dpa'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu dga' ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra sā dhu/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi legs so zhes bya bar gyur te byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur na/ rdo rje dgyes pa'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje dgyes pa'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi legs so zhes bya ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu dga' bar byed pa nyid yin pa dang / rab tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod/ e ma'o thams cad mkhyen kun gyi/ /legs sbyin nang na bdag mchog pas/ /rnam rtog bral ba de dag gis/ /nges par dgyes pa bskyed pa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyab na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/

/de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu dgyes pa bla na med pa'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad mgu bar byed pa dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes pa'i ro bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje dgyes pa de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje dgyes pa rdo rje dgyes pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje ming gis dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dgyes pas/ rdo rje dgyes pa'i dbyibs des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la legs so zhes bya bas rab tu dgyes par byed cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi legs sbyin pa/ /'di ni rab tu 'jug byas pas/ /rdo rje thams cad dgyes par byed/ /lha rdzas dgyes pa spel ba'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i dam tshig las byung ba'i rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra rat+na/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes shin tu rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/

bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ nam mkha' thams cad kyi 'od zer du gyur nas phung ngo / /nam mkha' thams cad kyi 'od zer de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas pas thams cad nam mkha'i dbyibs lta bur gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis nam mkha'i dbyings de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu bsgoms pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi snying po'i rang bzhin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mnyam par 'jug pa'i tshad tsam gyis rdo rje rin po che chen po'i dbyibs su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje rin po che'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbang bskur ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi snying po las shin tu byung ba nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o chags med rgyal ba yang / /khams gsum dbang por dgongs pas na/ /rdo rje rin chen bla med pa'i/ /dbang bskur mchog ni bdag yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan snga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nor bu rin po che'i dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad yongs su grub par bya ba dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje'i nor bu ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i snying po rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rdo rje nor bu de rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'jog cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sems can khams/ /dbang bskur de ni bdag yin te/ /bdag gi lag tu byin pas na/ /rin chen la ni rin chen bzhag /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzi brjid chen po zhes bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba'i rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra te dza/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje nyi ma'i dbyibs su gyur te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer 'gyed pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu gzi brjid che ba nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzi brjid chen po'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sems can khams kun tu/ /snang byed gzi brjid dpe med dag /gang phyir sangs rgyas dag pa yi/ /'dren pa rnams kyang sbyor bar byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid kyi sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'od zer gyi dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang gi 'od thob cing dngos grub dam pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje nyi ma de byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzi brjid chen po de'i lag tu de bzhin du byin no/

/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i 'od rdo rje'i 'od ces bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 'od kyis rdo rje'i nyi ma des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la snang bar byed cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snang ba 'di/ /mi shes mun nag 'joms byed pa/ /shin tu rdul phran ji snyed pa'i/ /nyi ma'i 'od bas shin tu lhag /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i dbal gyi dam tshig las byung ba'i rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying pa ོ 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra ke tu/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan kha dog dang gzugs dang rgyan dang dbyibs sna tshogs par gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dbyibs su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rin po che'i dbal nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin po che dbal gyi lus su gyur nas/

bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o don kun grub pa dang / /dgongs pa thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /don rnams thams cad rdzogs byed pa'i/ /'dra med dbal ni bdag yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin po che dbal gyi sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rgyal mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nor bu yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad re ba thams cad yongs su bkang bar bya ba dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don chen po'i dngos grub dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir rdo rje rgyal mtshan de byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i dbal de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor du bcug nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa kun/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul/

/de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag par dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i dbang po'i dam tshig las byung ba'i rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgyes pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra hā sā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dzum par gyur te byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje 'dzum pa'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzum pa'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rmad du byung ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rtag tu dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i dbang po nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag tu dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i dbang po'i lus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /rtag tu mnyam par bzhag rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas don la rab sbyor phyir/ /e ma'o bdag ni kun mchog gi/ /bzhad chen rmad du byung chen yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag par dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i dbang po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyab kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/

/de nas rnam snang gi dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmad du byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rmad du byung ba bskyed pa'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dbang po bla na med pa dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang po yongs su sbyong ba'i ye shes mngon par shes pa'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir rdo rjes 'dzum pa de/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag par dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i dbang po de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje dga' ba zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dga' bas rdo rje 'dzum pa des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes par byed cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rmad du byung bskyed ston pa po/ /dgyes chen byed pa'i ye shes te/ /gtsug lag gzhan gyis shes mi nus/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i dam tshig las byung ba'i chos kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas byung ngo / /badz+ra dhar+m+maḥ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/
