rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i chos mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer du gyur te byung ngo / /dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kun tu snang bar byas nas chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gyur to/ /chos kyi dbyings de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas nam mkha'i khams thams cad dang mnyam par 'jug pa'i tshad tsam gyis rdo rje pad+ma chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje pad+ma'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin du phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin ni shin tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i skur gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rang byung gdod nas dag /dam pa'i don no bdag yin te/ /gang phyir gzings 'dra'i chos rnams la/ /rnam par dag pa dmigs par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan snga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs pa'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur te/

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par sbyang ba'i dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyi bdag dang gzhan rnam par dag par bya ba dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi ye shes dang mngon par shes pa drug thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sku'i dbang bskur nas/ de'i lag tu rdo rje pad+ma de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i spyan rdo rje'i spyan zhes bya ba'i rdo rje ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i spyan gyis rdo rje pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pa 'dod chags rnam par dag cing ma chags pa'i ngo bo nyid gzigs pas gzigs shing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'dod chags de nyid rtogs byed pa/ /bdag de bdag gi lag tu sbyin/ /chos la chos ni gnas par gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gyi dam tshig las byung ba/ chos kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang ye shes chen po'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra tīk+ṣaḥ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang ye shes kyi ral grir gyur te phyung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje ral gri'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje ral gri'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang ye shes la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu 'jam pa'i dpal nyid yin pa dang / shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal chen po gzhon nu'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'jam dbyangs bdag ni yin par dgongs/ /gang phyir shes rab gzugs med kyang / /dbyangs nyid du ni dmigs pa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gyi sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang ye shes kyi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad gcod pa'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad gcod pa dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba'i shes rab dam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje ral gri de byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i blo rdo rje'i blo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i blos rdo rje'i ral gri des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'debs shing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /dgra rnams thams cad gcod byed cing / /sdig pa thams cad 'joms pa'i mchog /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dam tshig las byung ba chos kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra he ru/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje 'khor lo'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba nyid yin pa dang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/

byang chub sems dpa' chen po sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya ba'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /rdo rje dam pa chos can gyi/ /e ma'o rdo rje 'khor lo bdag /gang phyir sems bskyed tsam gyis kyang / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang / bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur te/ de nas rnam snang gi dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor lo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med par 'jug pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dam pa bsgrub pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo de byang chub sems dpa' chen po sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i snying po rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying pos rdo rje'i 'khor lo des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyir mi ldog pa nyid du 'jog cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/

/'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam par sbyong / /phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo yang / /byang chub snying po yin par dgongs/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po mi gsung ba'i dam tshig las byung ba chos kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bzlas pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra bha ṣa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid kyi yi ger gyur te byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje bzlas pa'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje bzlas pa'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni shin tu tshig ma yin pa nyid yin pa dang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po tshig ma yin pa'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rang byung rnams kyis gsang / /ldem po ngag tu bdag dgongs te/ /gang phyir dam pa'i chos 'chad pa/ /tshig tu spros las rnam par bral/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po tshig ma yin pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyab kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/

/de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i gsung rdo rje'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi ye shes kyi dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi tshig grub pa dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba nyid thob pa'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje bzlas pa de byang chub sems dpa' chen po tshig ma yin pa de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig rdo rje'i tshig ces bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i tshig gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rdo rje'i bzlas pa des yang dag par smra zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje'i bzlas par brjod pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sngags 'di myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i phrin las thams cad pa zhes bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba las kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra kar+m+ma/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni las thams cad pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes shin tu rtogs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las kyi 'od zer du gyur te byung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las kyi 'od zer de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dbyibs lta bur gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi dbyibs ma lus pa de yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs te/ nam mkha'i dbyibs thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam du gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dbyibs de las kyi rdo rje'i dbyibs su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las mtha' yas pa nyid yin pa dang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las thams cad ces bya ba'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas rnams kyis nges/ /phrin las mang po kun bdag yin/ /sangs rgyas don ni lhun grub phyir/ /rdo rje las ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las thams cad ces bya ba'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan sngar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs snga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig las byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa la 'jug pa la sogs pa gdon mi za ba tshad med pa dang / las kyi cho ga rgyas pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyi las thams cad 'grub pa dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i phrin las nyid dang ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rnams kyi dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ las kyi rdo rje de byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las thams cad pa de'i lags par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sna tshogs rdo rje sna tshogs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po sna tshogs rdo rje zhes bya ba des rdo rje de rang gi snying gar bzhag ste de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phrin las la sbyor zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa'i mchog /bdag de bdag gi lag tu byin/ /sna tshogs la ni sna tshogs bzhag /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus thub par dkar ba'i dam tshig las byung ba/ las kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsrung ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra rak+ṣa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi go cha brtan por gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje'i go cha'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje go cha'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsrung ba'i go cha rgyas pa'i las la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni brtson 'grus dam pa thub par dka' ba nyid yin pa dang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur te byang chub sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus thub par dka' ba'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o brtson 'grus go cha 'di/ /brtan pa'i bdag nyid rab brtan bdag /de ni brtan phyir lus min yang / /rdo rje'i lus su byed pa'i mchog /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus thub par dka' ba'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ /de bzhin gshegs thams cad kyi g.yas phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gi dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje brtan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig dang / sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad yongs su bskyang ba dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sku thob pa'i mchog 'grub par bya ba'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir rdo rje'i go cha de/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus thub par dka' ba de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i grogs po rdo rje'i grogs po zhes bya ba'i rdo rje ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i grogs pos rdo rje'i go cha des/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la go cha bskon zhing ched du brjod 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byams pa'i go cha dam pa ste/ /brtson 'grus brtan pas bsrung ba che/ /grogs po chen por brjod pa yin/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i dam tshig las byung ba'i las kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mche ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra yak+ṣa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon cha chen por gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te/ gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas rdo rje mche ba'i dbyibs su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje mche ba'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdug pa 'dul ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/

bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa nyid yin pa dang shin tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres pa gyur te byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud rab tu 'joms pa'i lus su gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni sangs rgyas rnams/ /thugs rje can gyi thabs yin te/ /zhi yang sems can don du ni/ /ma rungs par ni ston par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gis dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rab tu gtum pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams 'jigs pa med par bya ba dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thabs chen po'i ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rnams 'thob cing dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon cha de byang chub sems dpa' chen po bdud thams cad rab tu 'joms pa de'i lag par de bzhin du sbyin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i khro bo rdo rje khro bo zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khro bos rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon cha de rang gi khar bzhag nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bsdigs shing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/

/'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ma rungs thams cad 'dul ba'i mchog /rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon rno ste/ /thabs dang snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po khu tshur zhes bya ba'i dam tshig las byung ba las kyi byin gyis brlabs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje bcings pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra san dhi/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje de nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcings par gyur te byung nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas/ rdo rje bcings pa'i dbyibs su gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gnyis su gnas so/ /de nas rdo rje bcings pa'i dbyibs de las 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang ye shes la sogs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur shin tu bcings pa nyid yin pa dang rab tu brtan pa'i phyir gcig tu 'dres par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur zhes bya ba'i lus su gyur nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs la gnas te ched du brjod do/ e ma'o rab tu brtan bcings pa'i/ /dam tshig bdag ste brtan bdag nyid/ /bsam pa thams cad rab sgrub phyir/ /grol ba rnams kyang 'ching bar byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur gyi sku bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas phyung ste/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyab na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas yang bka' nod cing bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam snang gi dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya bcings pa'i dam tshig dang sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang lha thams cad kyi dgongs pa rtag pa dang grub pa thams cad dang bde ba dang yid bde ba thams cad myong bar bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang phyag rgya'i dbang dam pa grub pa'i dngos grub kyi dam pa thob pa'i bar du 'bras bu de dag gi phyir/ rdo rje bcings pa de byang chub sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khu tshur zhes bya ba de'i lag par de bzhin du byin no/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje khu tshur rdo rje khu tshur zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ming gi dbang gis dbang bskur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khu tshur zhes bya ba des rdo rje bcings pa des de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'ching zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya bcings pa che zhing brtan/ /sangs rgyas kun tu myur 'grub phyir/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa mi skyod pa zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes bsgrubs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /satwa badz+ri/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka las 'di byung ma thag tu rdo rje'i 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /'od zer de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur gyur nas byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rnams las phyag rgyas btab nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi rdo rje'i dbyibs chen por gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan sngar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje brtan pa bdag /gang phyir brtan pas lus med kyang / /rdo rje'i lus su gyur pa yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ba zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas gdab pa'i phyir rin po che'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rdo rje rin po che'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i rang gi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /rat+na badz+ri/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka las 'di byung ma thag tu rin po che'i 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /rin po che'i 'od zer de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul ni shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur gyur te/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas btab nas yang gcig tu 'dres te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi rdo rje rin po che chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi g.yas phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje rin chen bdag nyid grags/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dbang gi tshul ni brtan pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas btab pa'i phyir chos kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ chos kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i rang gi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /dhar+m+ma badz+ri/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka las 'di byung ma thag tu pad+ma'i 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /pad mo'i 'od zer de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas btab nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi rdo rje'i pad+ma chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyab kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi rdo rje gtsang ma bdag /gang phyir rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /'dod chags yin yang dri ma med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas gdab pa'i phyir/

pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi las kyi dam tshig ces bya ba'i rang gi phyag rgya 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /kar+m+ma badz+ri/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka las 'di byung ma thag tu las thams cad kyi 'od zer du gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ las thams cad kyi 'od zer de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la phyag rgyas btab nas yang gcig tu 'dres te 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang mnyam pa'i tshad tsam gyi thams cad du rtse mo bltas pa'i las kyi rdo rje chen po'i dbyibs su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /las kyi rdo rje mang po bdag /gang phyir gcig kyang sems can khams/ /ma lus par ni las bzang byed/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi lha mo chen mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra lā s+ye/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka las byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgyar gyur nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/

lha mo chen mo rdo rje 'dzin ma lus thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra zhing / kha dog dang gzugs dang mtshan ma dang spyod lam sna tshogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad sdud par gyur pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i lha mor gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rang byung rnams kyis ni/ /mchod pa bdag 'dra gzhan med de/ /gang phyir 'dod pa dga' mchod pas/ /mchod pa thams cad byas par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i phreng ba'i dbang gi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi lha mo chen po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra mā le/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i phyag rgyar gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i phyag rgya de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te lha mo chen po rdo rje phreng ba mar gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o rin chen mchod pa zhes/ /bdag dang 'dra bar grags pa med/ /gang phyir khams gsum rgyal mchog kyang / /rab tu mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi klu'i mchod pa mchog gi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glu'i lha mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra gī ti/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi phyag rgyar gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi phyag rgya de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te lha mo chen mo rdo rje'i glur gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni kun gzigs pa'o/ /glu mchog tshul gyi mchod pa yin/ /gang phyir sgra brnyan 'dra ba yi/ /mchod pa rnams kyis mnyes par byed/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar gyi mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi lha mo chen po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra nṛ ti/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar gyis mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gar gyis mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par gyur pa de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas yang gcig tu 'dres te/ lha mo chen mo rdo rje gar gyi skur gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das gdon mi za bar grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/

/e ma'o mchod kun don mdzad pa'i/ /mchod pa rgya chen bdag yin te/ /gang phyir rdo rje gar cho gas/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rab tu byed/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu tshim pa'i dam tshig las byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi g.yog mo'i gtso mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra dhū pe/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ bdug pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi bkod pa rnam pa du mas rdo rje'i dbyings thams cad khyab par byung nas byung ngo / /bdug pa'i mchod pa'i rgya mtsho de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas rdo rje bdug pa'i lha mo'i lus su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho'i grwar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bdag ni mchod pa che/ /rab tu sim ldan dge ba yi/ /gang phyir sems can dbab ldan pas/ /myur du byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs rin chen 'byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rin po che'i mchod pa'i rgyan gyi dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsol kha ma 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo /

/badz+ra puṣ+pe/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ me tog thams cad kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi bkod pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab par byed par gyur nas byung ngo / /me tog thams cad kyis mchod pa'i bkod pa de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste gcig tu 'dres nas rdo rje me tog gi lha mo'i skur gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs kyi khang bu rtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che las byas pa'i lho nub kyi grwar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o me tog mchod pa dag /thams cad kyis ni rgyan byed de/ /gang phyir mchod nas de bzhin gshegs/ /rin chen nyid du myur du 'grub/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang po'i rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang ba'i mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pho nya mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra ā lo ke/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de thams cad du snang ba'i mchod pa'i bkod pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad khyab par byed par gyur nas byung ngo / /thams cad du snang ba'i mchod pa'i bkod pa de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste gcig tu 'dres nas lha mo rdo rje snang ba zhes bya ba'i lus su gyur te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i nub byang gi grwar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o mchod pa'i mar me 'di/ /rgya chen dge ba bdag yin te/ /gang phyir snang byas myur du ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan yang thob/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub par/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi mchod pa'i lan du slar mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dri yis mchod pa'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bran mo 'di rang gis thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra gan+dhe/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las byung ma thag pa 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid de/ dri thams cad kyis mchod pa'i bkod pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par gyur nas byung ngo / /dri thams cad kyis mchod pa'i bkod pa de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas lha mo dri zhes bya ba'i lus su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon phyogs su khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i byang shar gyi grwar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o dri yi rang bzhin gyis/ /mchod pa lha rdzas yid 'ong bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dri/ /lus rnams kun la sbyin par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi lcags kyu'i dam tshig las byung ba sems dpa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i tshogs thams cad kyi bdag po 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra aṃ ku sha/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i tshogs su gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i sku gnyis su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i shar sgo phyi nang gnyis kyi sgo khang gi nang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dam tshig gis spyan 'dren zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag spyan 'dren brtan pa'i bdag /gang phyir bdag gis spyan drangs pas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la brten par 'gyur/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa sems dpa' chen po'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya la 'jug pa zhags pa ma 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra pā sha/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i tshogs su gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje zhags pa zhes bya ba'i sku gnyis su gyur te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i rdo rje rin chen gyi lho sgo phyi nang gnyis kyi sgo khang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'jug cing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje zhags pa dam po bdag /rdul phran zhugs pa thams cad kyang / /bdag gis slar yang drang bar bya/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi lcags sgrog sems dpa' chen po'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsdams pas pho nya mo 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsdams pa'i phyag rgya mang por gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsdams pa'i phyag rgya mang po de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lcags sgrog ces bya ba'i sku gnyis su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i rdo rje chos kyi nub sgo phyi nang gnyis kyi sgo khang gi nang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'ching zhing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog dam po'i bdag /'ching ba kun las grol ba rnams/ /sems can don du 'ching bar 'dod/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbab pa zhes bya ba'i sems dpa' chen po'i dam tshig las byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya thams cad kyi bran 'di rang gi thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /badz+ra ā be sha/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs las 'di byung ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i tshogs thams cad du gyur nas byung ste bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi skur gyur nas byung ste yang gcig tu 'dres nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje dbab pa'i sku gnyis su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khang bu brtsegs pa rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i rdo rje las kyi byang sgo phyi nang gnyis kyi sgo khang na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'bebs shing ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa bdag /kun gyi bdag tu gyur nas kyang / /bran du yang ni gyur pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rdo rje se gol gyi mtshan ma mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdu ba'i byin gyis brlabs 'di gsungs so/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de nas skad cig thang cig yud tsam de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad se gol gyi mtshan mas bsdus pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams sprin gyi rgya mtsho thams cad nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mang po dang bcas te 'dus nas khang bu brtsegs pa'i rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu dang rin po che las byas pa'i nang ga la ba dang /

bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ga la ba der gshegs nas ched du brjod do/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da ban da nāṃ ka ro mi zhes brjod do/ /rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dgar zlos shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o byang chub sems 'di ni/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes/ /de nas de skad ces gsungs pa dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas 'dus pa'i rnam snang thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs kar sems ma bzhi dang / mi bskyod pa thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs kar shar phyogs kyi lha thams cad dang / rin 'byung thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs kar lho phyogs kyi lha thams cad dang / 'od dpag med thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs kar nub phyogs kyi lha thams cad dang / don grub thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i thugs kar byang phyogs kyi lha thams cad thim/ de nas rigs lnga po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs so/ /de nas thugs kar gnas pa'i rigs lnga'i rnam snang gi thugs ka nas sems ma bzhi byung ste phyogs bzhi'i sems ma bzhi la thim/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs ka nas shar phyogs kyi lha rnams byung / shar phyogs kyi lha so so la thim/ skal bzang rnams phyi'i lha rnams la 'khod/ rin 'byung gi thugs ka nas lho phyogs kyi lha rnams byung / lho'i lha so so la thim/ skal bzang rnams phyi'i lha rnams la 'khod/ 'od dpag med kyi thugs ka nas nub phyogs kyi lha rnams byung / nub kyi lha so so la thim/ skal bzang rnams phyi'i lha rnams la 'khod/ don grub kyi thugs ka nas byang phyogs kyi lha rnams byung / byang gi lha so so la thim/

skal bzang rnams phyi'i lha rnams la 'khod nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba med/ /rdul phran thams cad ji snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gcig tu gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñca māṃ nas kye rdo rje dbyings kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ badz+ra pa aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra a be sha a/ sa ma ya satwaṃ nas/ badz+ra karma hūm̐ gi bar dang / su ra ta stoṃ/ re re'i mgor sbyar la/ badz+ra satwa dṛ sh+ya sogs nas/ badz+ra san dhi baṃ gyi bar dang / satwa badz+ri/ rat+na badz+ri/ dharma badz+ri/ karma badz+ri/ dṛ sh+ya sogs sbyar la nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha'i bar gyi rjes su/ badz+ra dz+nyā na lnga dang / sa ma ya satwaṃ nas/ sarba sid dhi'i bar dang / satwa badz+ri sogs bzhi dang / ma hā ra ti nas/ ghaṇ+ṭa āḥ.a'i bar dang / badz+ra dhā tu nas/ ā be sha aḥ'i bar dang / yang badz+ra dhā tu nas/ badz+ra ā be sha'i rjes gong bzhin du yum bzhi'i snying po dang bcas pa dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ ṭu/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi nas/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na nas/ tu ṣ+ya ho'i bar sngar bzhin/ badz+ra dhā tu/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdu ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa thams cad kyi mjug la sbyar la/ badz+ra dhā tu/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i/ badz+ra dhā tu/ bcom ldan 'das rin 'byung gis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ badz+ra dhā tu/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ badz+ra dhā tu/ bcom ldan 'das don grub kyis brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i/

satwa badz+ri/ sems ma rdo rje mas rigs thams cad bsdus par rgyas gdab pa'i/ rat+na badz+ri rin chen rdo rje mas rigs thams cad bsdus par rgyas gdab pa'i/ dharma badz+ri/ rdo rje chos mas rigs thams cad bsdus par rgyas gdab pa'i/ karma badz+ri/ rdo rje las mas rigs thams cad bsdus par rgyas gdab pa'i/ badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i/ badz+ra rā dz+ra/ rdo rje rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba'i/ badz+ra rā ga rdo rje chags pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par bya ba'i/ badz+ra sā dhu/ rdo rje legs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgyes pa'i/ badz+ra rat+na/ rdo rje rin chen gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dbang bskur ba'i/ badz+ra te dza/ rdo rje gzi brjid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od kyis snang bar bya ba'i/ badz+ra ke tu/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par sbyor ba'i/ badz+ra hā sa/ rdo rje bzhad pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dzum pa rmad du byung ba la nges par sbyor ba'i/ badz+ra dharma/ rdo rje chos rab kyis shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs par bya ba'i/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa/ rdo rje rnon pos nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad gcod pa'i/ badz+ra he tu/ rdo rje rgyus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i/ badz+ra bhā kha/ rdo rje smra bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spros pa med pa'i chos la nges par sbyor ba'i/ badz+ra karma/ rdo rje las rab kyis mchod pa ma lus shing lus pa med pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i/ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ rdo rje srung bas theg pa gzhan la 'dod pa'i sems dang nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las srung ba'i/ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis bsrung ba thams cad las yongs su bskyab pa'i/

badz+ra san dhi/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis sku dang gsung dang thugs gcig tu byed pas bcings pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi khu tshur gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskyed pa'i/ badz+ra lā s+ye/ rdo rje sgeg mos sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ badz+ra mā le/ phreng ba mas tshul khrims kyi/ badz+ra gī ti/ glu mas bzod pa'i pha rol tu/ badz+ra nṛ ti/ gar mas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu/ badz+ra dhū pe/ bdug pa mas shes rab kyi pha rol tu/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ me tog mas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ mar me mas smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ badz+ra gan dhe/ dri chab mas thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha/ lcags kyu mas byang chub sems kyi lcags kyus sems can thams cad thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du dgug pa'i/ badz+ra pā sha/ zhags pa mas pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i spyod pa la gzhug pa'i/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa/ lcags sgrog mas theg pa gzhan 'dod pa las sems dral ba'i/ badz+ra ā be sha 'bebs pas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing skye ba med par dbab pa'i/ sar+b+ba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dhe dhar+m+ma te ga ga na sa mud+ga te ma hā yā na sa pā ri wā re/ skal bzang rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi grong khyer bskyang ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa lan bzhi bya'o/ /las rgyal mchog go /de nas badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs mchod pa bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin byas la/ oṃ badz+rod gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/

/khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas nas gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /shin tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyis na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pad+ma tsan+d+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ sogs lnga brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang /

/phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la/ /rdo rje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la/ /rdo rje legs pa sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che/ /rab dgyes rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dgyes khyod la/ /rdo rje rin chen rdo rje don/ /rdo rje nam mkha' nor bu che/ /nam mkha' snying po rdo rje phyug /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'char ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la/ /sems can don rab rdo rje dpal/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed/ /rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpal khyod la/ /rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che/ /rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la/ /rdo rje chos rab de nyid don/ /rdo rje pad mo rab dga' byed/ /'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje can/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la/ /rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje blo khyod la/ /rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che/ /rdo rje 'khor lo tshul chen po/ /rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gsum ba rab rib mchog /rdo rje zlos pa rab bsgrub sbyin/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchog bsgrub pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rje'i bka'/ /las kyi rdo rje kun rab sgrol/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la/ /rdo rje bsrung ba brtan pa che/

/rdo rje go cha sra ba che/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni thub par dka'/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje brtson 'grus la/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la/ /rdo rje mtshams sbyor rab bsdus nyid/ /rdo rje 'ching ba rab grol byed/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ badz+ra san dhi baṃ/ oṃ ṭuṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da ban nāṃ ka ro mi/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ badz+ra ma dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ badz+ra dhā tu dṛ sh+ya sogs phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ ṭaruṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tuṣ+ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ ha badz+ri ṇi nas/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur la/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga puṣ+pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ nas/ mar me dang rol mo'i bar du dbul/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /sogs sgeg sogs brgyad kyi rjes su/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul ma lus pa/ /rang gi bdag nyid bsgoms nas su/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi sbyor ba yis/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta tha thā ga ta badz+ra dhā tu a nut+ta ra pū dza s+pha ra ṇa karma sa ma ye sa hūm̐/ bdag ni mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /bdag gis khams ni rnam par spros/ /byang chub sems ni spros nas su/ /thub pa'i dbang phyug rnams la 'bul/ /dhā tu'i gnas su badz+ra satwa sbyar/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis dang tha ma 'dra/ /rdo rje rin chen spros nas ni/

/badz+ra rat+na/ rkang pa dang po gnyis dang 'dra/ rmad byung chen po spros nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /badz+ra dhar+m+ma/ rkang pa dang po gnyis dang tha ma 'dra/ /rdo rje las rnams spro bya zhing / /badz+ra karma/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid yang dang yang du ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sar+b+ba āt+mā naṃ nirmā ta na pū dza s+pha ra ṇa karma badz+ri āḥ rdo rje lcags kyu bdag rang nyid/ /phyogs kun tu ni spro bar bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgug bya zhing / /thub pa dag la dbul bar bya/ /s+pha ra ṇa yan chad 'gre/ /ka rma a gri dzaḥ rdo rje'i rigs ni rjes chags par/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /chos rnams bdag la mnyes bya zhing / /'di brjod nas ni spro bar bya/ /nir+yā ta na yan chad 'dra/ /a nu rā ga ṇa pū dza s+pha ra ṇa karmā wa ṇe hūm̐ ho/ /rdo rje rin chen rnal 'byor che/ /bdag nyid yongs su bsgom par bya/ /rin chen mchod pa bla na med/ /phyogs rnams kun tu spro bar bya/ /nir+yā ta na yan chad 'dra/ sā dhu kā ra pū dza s+pha ra ṇa karma tuṣ+ṭi āḥ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal po che/ /byang chub snying por dbang bskur ba/ /sems kyang de ltar sems na ni/ /rdo rje rin chen nyid thob 'gyur/ /oṃ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣe ka ta rat+ne bh+yo badz+ra ma ṇi oṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje gzi brjid che/ /phyogs rnams kun tu snang byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskul bya zhing / /mchod pa gzi brjid yongs su spro/ /ga ta yan chad 'dra/ ma hā sur+ye bh+yo badz+ra te dzi ni dz+wā la hriḥ rdo rje rgyal mtshan kun tu mtho/ /shes rab can gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod bya zhing / /rdo rje sngags kyis bskul nas mchod/ /ā sha pa ri pu ri ṇa tsin+tā ma ṇi dh+wa dz+wa gri bh+yo badz+ra dh+wa dza gri traṃ/ grags chen sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/

/dkyil 'khor shes rab can gyis blta/ /rtag tu bdag nyid dga' bya zhing / /rdo rje sngags kyis bskul nas mchod/ /ma hā pri ti pra mod+ya ka re bh+yo badz+ra ha sa ha/ sems can thams cad chos chen po/ /bdag ni chos chen dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag nyid kun/ /rdo rje sngags kyis rab bskul mchod/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhar+m+ma sa mā dhi bhi tu no mi ma hā dhar+m+ma a gri hi/ bdag ni shes rab ral gri rno/ /shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul/ /'khor lo'i yi ge rab tu skor/ /mdo sde thams cad 'dzin pa yin/ /gā ta yan chad 'dra/ padz+nyā pā ra mi tā nir ha tistu no mi ma hā gho ṣa a nu ge dhaṃ/ bdag ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sbyin byed pa/ /rdo rje 'khor lo yongs su bsngo/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spro bya/ /tsakra ak+ṣa ra pa ri waṃrta sar+b+ba su tran ta ye stu no mi sar+b+ba maṇ+ḍa le hūm̐/ sems can dag ni kun gyi tshig /bdag gis sems can smra ba bstan/ /rdo rje smra ba gsang ba'i bdag /sangs rgyas thams cad rab mchod bya/ /san dhi bhā ṣa bud+dha saṃ gī ti birgā yaṃ tu no mi badz+ra bā tse baṃ/ bdag ni rdo rje las rgyal po/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rab mchod byed/ me tog bdug pa la sogs dri/ /rdo rje sngags kyis bskul bar bya/ dhū pa me gha s+pha ra ṇa pū dza karme ka ra ka ra/ go cha bgos pa dang ldan pa/ /me tog mchod pa 'bul byed pa/ /bdag nyid rang nyid rgyal po ste/ /rdo rje sngags ni rab bskul bya/ /puṣ+pa pra sa ra s+pha ra ṇa pū dza karme ki ri ki ri/ bdag ni rdo rje gnod sbyin te/ /nyon mongs za byed chos sgron 'bar/ /phyogs rnams kun tu spro bya zhing / /snang ba 'bar ba'i yang dag spro/ /ā lo ke dz+wa la s+pha ra ṇa pū dza karme ka ra ka ra/ rdo rje khu tshur yang dag nyid/ /dri yi snod dang yang dag ldan/ /phyogs rnams kun tu spro bya zhing /

/char rnams kun gyis rab mchod bya/ /gan dha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa pū dza karme ku ru ku ru/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pu dzo nas/ kar+m+ma ku ru māṃ zhes pa'i bar bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ oṃ sar+b+ba sa mo haṃ/ yi ge brgya pa lan bdun dang / badz+ra satwa/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su lha'i snying po'am sngags mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu dus mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer can rdor sems kyi snying po'am lha thams cad kyi sngags ci nus bzlas par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa rkyang par byed pa de'i rjes su/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ sogs kyis bstod/ mchod yon dang nyer mchod lnga dang / lha mo brgyad dang / rig ma bcu drug gi mchod sngags tsam dang / phyag bzhi byas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥnas/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥbadz+ra muḥ zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ sar+b+ba mu dri me dri ḍhi ku ru ba ra ka ba tso na baṃ/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ badz+ra satwa dang / yig brgya brjod/ dge ba bsngos la bdag gi cho ga ma tshang ba gang dag bgyis pa de bzod par mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs par mdzod/ /de nas slar yang 'byon par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa muḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra san dhi baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra karma kaṃ oṃ legs so rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos khyod legs pa ste/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /mdo sde 'di ni legs bshad pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mdor bsdus pa'o/ /bsnyen pa rgyas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ bsnyen pa'i rjes su ḍak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥnas yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro'i bar sngar bzhin/

de nas mtshan brgyas bstod nas/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis/ /bdag cag gis ni bstod pa yin/ /theg pa chen po rtogs pa yi/ /tshul chen yang ni rgyas par mdzod/ /mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yi/ /cho ga mchog ni bshad par gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da ban dha nāṃ ka ro mi/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang yin/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen rdo rje can bdag yin/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /phyag na rdo rje brtan bdag yin/ /bdag po rdo rje chen po bdag /byin gyis brlab pa mi 'dor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ mig g.yas g.yon dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ āḥlas rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje badz+ra satwa u tiṣ+ṭha/ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ ri rab kyi rtse mo nas 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ khro bo me ltar 'bar bar bskyed pa nas badz+ra ban dha baṃ gyi bar bsrung 'khor bzhin bya/ badz+rod gha ṭa sogs kyis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sgo phye la/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ṭal hūm̐ dza/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi khro bo mi'u thung lta bu zhal bzhi pa gsus khyim che ba ral pa can phyag dang po gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya dang 'og ma gnyis g.yas na 'khor lo/ /g.yon rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa sku mdog ser po bkug nas gzhal yas khang la thim pas zhal bzhi sgo bzhi/ khog pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan du gyur/ ma hā badz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha si dh+ya hūm̐/ hūm̐ las khro bo mtha' yas gser mdog can g.yas sngo g.yon dkar/ phyag dang po gnyis mnyam bzhag g.yas gnyis phreng ba dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub dang gzhu/

khro bo rnam rgyal sngon po khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas rdor dril 'dzin pa/ khro bo sprin 'dra char sprin lta bu g.yas dkar/ g.yon ser/ g.yas ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ gzhu bsnams pa/ khro bo gsus po che dmar po rdo rje phreng ba'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa rgyal ba dmar po g.yas sngo/ /g.yon dkar ba/ stag lpags can/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ dbyug to/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na sdigs mdzub dang sdigs mdzub dkur brten pa/ pad+ma/ gzhu 'dzin par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sar+b+ba bighān ban dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya ghā ta ya sar+b+ba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sar+b+ba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ las bum la bsangs sbyangs sngar bzhin byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las hriḥlas pad+ma/ āḥlas zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po lto ba yangs pa sogs sngar bzhin dang / badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥsogs nas/ badz+ra a be sha āḥ badz+ra yak+ṣa dṛ sh+yā nas/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gi bar dang / shatruṃ bhak+ṣa/ badz+ra yak+ṣa/ lan gnyis dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā twi shwa ri hūm̐ badz+ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñca nas/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya'i bar dang / badz+ra yak+ṣa/ de nas puṣ+pe sogs lnga dang / sgeg sogs brgyad dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ dang / oṃ badz+ra san dhi baṃ/ oṃ ṭuṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ sa'i cho ga ste nub dang po'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re ru ṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra dhā tu nas/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ skā ra'i bar/ nam mkha' nas phab pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sogs nas/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bar sngar bzhin brjod la/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su seng ge'i khri dang pad zla'i steng du/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī shwa ri hūm̐ lan bdun dang / rnam snang dkar po rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/

nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ lha rdzas kyi dar la'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mnabs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ zhal dang po/ shar du gzigs pa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ lan bdun kun la 'gre/ shar gyi dbus su glang po che'i khri dang pad zla la mi skyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa oṃ badz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ lhor rta'i khri dang pad zla la rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rdo rje rin po che bsnams pa/ oṃ badz+ra dhar+m+ma hūm̐/ nub tu rma bya'i khri dang pad zla la 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas rdo rje pad+ma bsnams pa/ oṃ badz+ra kar+m+ma hūm̐/ byang du nam mkha' lding gi khri dang pad+ma zla la don grub ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ lan bdun bdun kun la 'gre/ rnam snang gi mdun du sems ma rdo rje ma'i ngo bo rdo rje lnga pa dmar po/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ g.yas su rin chen rdo rje ma'i ngo bo yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rtse mo dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa/ oṃ dhar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ rgyab tu rdo rje chos ma'i ngo bo pad+ma dkar dmar 'dab ma bcu drug pa la 'dab ma brgyad kha thur du gyes shing kha bye ba/ 'dab ma brgyad kha gyen du bltas pa kha ma bye ba'i nang na dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa chud pa/ oṃ kar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐/ g.yon du rdo rje las ma'i ngo bo sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa lte ba dkar/ mdun gyi rwa gsum sngo/ g.yas kyi ser/ g.yon gyi ljang / rgyab kyi dmar ba/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ mi bskyod pa'i mdun du rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha āḥ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar sngar bzhin la sems dpa' bcu drug po de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mdun g.yas g.yon dang rgyab/

sgeg sogs bzhi/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang / byang shar gyi re mig dang / bdug pa ma sogs phyi'i grwa bzhi dang / sgo ba bzhi la phyi nang gi shar sgo sogs sbyar/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ skā ras dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar gyi snam bu la byams pa la sogs pa'i skal bzang nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dkar po/ g.yas dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃskā ra dang / lho'i snam bu la dpal sbas la sogs pa'i skal bzang nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu ser po/ g.yas rin po che rang gis dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'jog cing g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ skā ra dang / nub kyi snam bu la ye shes grags pa la sogs pa'i skal bzang nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dkar dmar g.yon pa snyems pa dang bcas pas rdo rje pad+ma'i sdong bu dkur brten zhing g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis snying gar rdo rje pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃskā ra dang / byang gi snam bu la spyan sdug pa'i zhal la sogs pa skal bzang nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu sna tshogs mdog sngar bzhin/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa thugs kar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas sna tshogs rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba/ de nas ma lus sems can kun nas nyer mchod lngas mchod pa'i bar dang / aṃ ku sha nas/ ā be sha'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ badz+ra dhā tu nas/ sar+b+ba saṃ skā ra'i bar brjod/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa sngar bzhin byas la/

stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a ha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar te lha sta gon no/ /rnam rgyal bum pa bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ hrīḥlas pad+ma āḥlas zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las khro bo gnod sbyin dang rdo rje sems dpa' dang me ltar 'bar ba gsum sngar bzhin bskyed/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha nas/ ā be sha'i bar dang / badz+ra yak+ṣa/ badz+ra satwa/ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka dṛ sh+ya sbyar bar dang / sha truṃ bhak+ṣa/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐/ yak+ṣa sogs lan gnyis dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā twi shwā ri nas tu ṣ+ya ho'i bar dang / mchod yon sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang sgeg sogs kyis mchod/ yang sngags gsum po de nyid bzlas te bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas phyi rol tu gtor ma sbyin te/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas la/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad tshogs bcas g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar te khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir byon cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gnas pa dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can la gang gnas dang /

/grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dkar thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dang ni sum mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes te mgu bar gyur nas su/ /me tog phreng ba dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen bdun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis pa mdzod/ /oṃ in+dā ya swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ ya mā ya swā hā/ oṃ nai ṛ t+yā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swa hā/ oṃ bā ya be swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ī shā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ brah+ma ṇe swā hā/ oṃ sūr+yā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsan+dā ya swāhā/

oṃ pri thi wī bh+yaḥswāhā/ oṃ nā ge bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ a su re bh+yaḥswā hā/ na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sar+b+ba tatakhaṃ ud+ga te smra ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdag cag la bgegs med par mdzod cig las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsregs bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'iྎ/ mchod cingྎ/ lha yi bdag poྎ/ man chad kun la 'gre/ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal poྎ/ lho phyogsྎ/ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub srin po'iྎ/ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /tshig bsrungs gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /nub phyogsྎ/ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyalྎ/ nub byangྎ/ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor srung gdon gyiྎ/ byang phyogsྎ/ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal poྎ/ byang shar dbang ldan tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cingྎ/ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /zla ba nyi ma gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ mchod cingྎ/ 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cingྎ/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/

/bya byed ngan rnams med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de nas mtshan brgyas bstod/ nyer mchod lnga/ lha mo brgyad/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ phyag bzhi bya/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /gsang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming / /rdo rje dbyings ni ci nus kyis/ /cho ga bzhin du bri lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum dang / oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pā da sogs dang / yang mtshan brgyas bstod/ badz+ra satwa dang / nyer mchod lngas mchod/ phyag bya/ yang mtshan brgyas bstod/ badz+ra dhā tu/ badz+ra muḥnas badz+ra san dhi baṃ gyi bar sngar bzhin bya ste sta gon no/ /de nas bdag rdzogs byas la/ thig skud sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa/ ser po traṃ las rin 'byung / dmar po hriḥlas 'od dpag med/ ljang gu aḥlas don grub/ dkar po āḥlas rnam snang / mig gnyis dzaḥlas nyi ma zla ba/ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi aṃ ku shi dzaḥ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i thig gdab pa'i phyir/

rdo rje'i thig bdag la stsol cig dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi aṃ ku shi dzaḥ an+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma pa raspa ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sar+b+ba dhar+m+ma a t+yan+ta/ a nu pra bi ṣ+ṭa: sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi zla/ badz+ra driṣ+ṭi phaṭa mtshan pa/ badz+ra driṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ nyer mchod lngas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ rigs lnga'i sngags kyang brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas rigs lnga sems dpa' bcu drug rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags brjod/ nyer mchod lnga dang lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ pā da ban dha sogs kyis phyag bya/ yang mig gnyis dzaḥlas nyi zla ser po snang ba/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa nas/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya ā'i bar dang / rol mos mchod/ badz+ra dhā tu/ badz+ra kar+m+ma/ badz+ra satwa dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sems can gyi don gyi phyir 'dir gshegs par gsol/ rang rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi mig g.yas g.yon hīḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba/ huṃ thung las mig 'bras gnyis khro bo bo'i rdo rje/ kro dha dṛṣ+ṭi hīḥ kro dha dṛṣ+ṭi hāṃḥrdul tshon bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las ā hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas rigs lngar bskyed/ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi aṃ ku shi dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ rigs lnga'i sngags lan bdun bdun brjod la hīḥhīḥ.oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūm̐/ thig tshon byin brlabs so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bris tshar ba dang / dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni sngar dang 'dra/ lha thams cad sku mdog phyag mtshan sngar bzhin bskyed badz+ra dhā tu dṛsh+ya nas/ sar+b+ba saṃ ka ri'i bar sngar bzhin gyis phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab/ dkyil 'khor bris zin nas tshogs lhag ma rnams mchod pas mchod/ ye shes pa gshegs/ oṃ badz+ra be ga ā kra ma hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na sogs dang /

oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad sku mdog sngon po g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ badz+rod gha ṭa sa ma ya kra be sha ya hūm̐/ de nas rnal 'byor chen po byas la/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ lha bum gang bum rnams kyi nang du/ rang rang gi sa bon las lha so so dang 'jug sgo'i bum par yang rdor sems sngar bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab dbang bskur mchod pa sngar bzhin bya/ rnam rgyal la badz+ra satwa brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐ stong rtsa brgyad/ 'jug sgo'i bum par oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad dang / lha so so'i bum par rang rang gi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ gang bum la rang rang gi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ badz+ra a da ka lan bdun bdun brjod/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /yon chab rgyun yang mi 'chad pa/ /bla ma yi dam lha la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ā ha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar ro/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzāḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha āḥ phyag bzhi bya/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar 'tshal lo'i bar sngar bzhin dang / gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsol/ thub pa nyi ma ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni/ /slob dpon dpang du gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba'i/ /mi ldog pa yi 'khor los 'byor/
