/thar pa'i rang bzhin grong khyer ched/ /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba chen po bsdus pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur chen po rmad byung ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /che ge zhes bya 'di nyid ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'dir yang 'jug par 'tshal/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba chen po 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ /zhes sogs nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje/ oṃ sar+b+ba yo ga tsit+ta u ta pā da yā mi/ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ ho/ badz+ra sidhi ya thā su khaṃ/ badz+ra sid+dhi ya tha sems su gyur/ thugs kar dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dpral bar rdo rje rin chen/ mgrin par rdo rje pad+ma/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje/ satwa badz+ri/ rat+na badz+ra/ dhar+m+ma badz+ri/ kar+m+ma badz+ri/ nyer mchod lngas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca sa ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra ā be sha āḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'grub pa yang thob na/

dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par byas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yin gyis gal te 'ga' zhig la smras na klad pa 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ slob dpon āḥlas rdo rje sems su gyur pa'i snying gar zla ba la rdo rje'i dbus su āḥrdo rje lta bu'i 'od zer dang ldan par gyur/ slob ma rang nyid hūm̐ las rdor sems kyi sku rdul dang bral zhing dwangs pa shel ltar gyur ba'i snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje/ dpral bar trāṃ las rin po che/ lkog mar hriḥlas pad+ma/ spyi bor kaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ badz+ra ud gha ṭa sogs kyis slob dpon dang rang gi thugs ka'i sgo phye la/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i rdo rje las aḥbyung zhing rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje dbus su zhugs pas āḥrdo rje'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang ldan pas rang gi lus thams cad gang āḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs la rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig 'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di/ /de ring nyid du 'bab par shog /badz+ra ā be sha āḥ lan bcu brjod/ badz+ra satwa āḥ.āḥ.āḥ kye rdo rje sems dpa'/ kye rdo rje rin chen/ kye rdo rje chos/ kye rdo rje las/ nṛ t+ya badz+ra/

nṛ t+ya satwa/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi mthar/ badz+ra muḥbatags pa lan bzhi bzhi'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ ṭuṃ/ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ.oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa satwaṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /mig 'bras gnyis su hūm̐ las rdo rje/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ye/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra nas/ ha ha ho'i bar brjod/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ satwa badz+ra sogs bzhi dang / badz+ra satwas rang dbang stegs la 'khod/ mchod yon dang nyer mchod lngas mchod/ bkra shis brjod/ sa ma ya aḥlus kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje sems dpa'/ snying ga'i g.yas su rgyal po/ g.yon du chags pa/ rgyab tu legs pa/ dpral bar rin chen/ ltag par gzi brjid/ phrag pa gnyis su rgyal mtshan/ so'i phreng ba gnyis su bzhad pa/ lkog mar chos/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar du rnon po/ lte bar rgyu/ lce la smra ba/ spyi bor rdo rje las/ nam tshoms su srung ba/ khar gnod sbyin/ dku gnyis su khu tshur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i g.yon du sgeg mo/ rdo rje rin chen gyi g.yon du phreng ba ma/ rdo rje chos kyi g.yon du glu ma/ rdo rje las kyi g.yon du gar ma/ gsang gnas su bdug pa ma/ mgo bor me tog ma/ mig gnyis su mar me ma/ nu ma dang brang dang snying gar byug pa ma/ brla g.yas su lcags kyu/ g.yon du zhags pa/ byin pa g.yas su lcags sgrog g.yon du 'bebs pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha'i bar dang / badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ su ra ta satwaṃ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/

/'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas pad ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad 'grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi las dgyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba'i/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum bi'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis brten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas mchog rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni sogs kun la 'gre/ grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon phyung ste/

/dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkris des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /baiḍū+ur+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtswa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram na tsar+ṣa'i phreng gis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /grong khyer wā rā ṇa sir drang song mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang gzhig phan byed dam pa dag pa la/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/

/tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man dā ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /de nas mtshan brgyas bstod/ de nas lcags kyu/ bdug pa ma/ sgeg mo/ sems ma rdo rje ma/ legs pa/ chags pa/ rgyal po/ rdor sems rnams kyi rang rang gi snying po badz+ra aṃ ku sha la sogs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca btags shing rang rang gi gang bum de nas lha bum gyis dbang bskur/ de nas rnam rgyal nas rdo rje khu tshur gyis chu blugs la badz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ de bzhin du badz+ra pā sha nas/ badz+ra rat+na/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes pa'i bar gyis gang bum dang lha bum dang rnam rgyal gyi dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs kyi brgyad dang rnam rgyal dang / byang phyogs kyi brgyad dang rnam rgyal/ de nas mi bskyod pa nas rnam snang gi bar du rang rang gi sngags la oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca btags la dbang bskur/ de nas yang rnam rgyal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐/ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñca maṃ nas/ oṃ kar+m+ma badz+ri ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ gyi bar dang / oṃ ṭuṃ/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ de nas sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang nas/ kye rdo rje dbyings kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'o yi bar dang / ṭak+ki dzaḥnas/ yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad yan nas/

hi hi hi hi hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ de nas nyer mchod lnga dang sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥ.a badz+ra satwa/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes par gyis/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni sbyor ba yis/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /aḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par byos shig hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su mnyes par bgyi'o/ /hoḥrdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di kun tu 'gro ba yin par shes par gyis shig a badz+ra satwa/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pas/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar gyis/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya zhing / dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul cho ga /'jig rten 'di la rab tu sgrogs/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /kun tu khyod la srung bar byed/ /'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/

/chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du/ rdo rje dang / khro bo dang / pad ma dang / nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes pa'i bar tshigs bcad lnga brjod/ oṃ/ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye rdo rje dbyings kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sid+dhi sa ma ya stoṃ bhūr bhu wa swaḥgang la gzengs bstod par bya ba 'di dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i cho gas lung bstan par bya ba de la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang gi dam tshig gi slob dpon dang mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad do/ /'di ltar gzengs bstod pa dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i dam pa'i dngos grub kyis byin gyis brlabs dang / sngags kyi stobs yin zhes dad par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di rang gis zungs shig 'di ni bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i snod du gyur pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma 'di la bdag gis bstsal lags so/ /khyed 'di dang nye bar mdzod cig khyod bcom ldan 'das ma 'di dang nye bar mdzod cig oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ zhes bya ba gsungs pa 'di/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bzung lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang bcom ldan 'das ma'i snod du gyur pa bdag lags so/ /khyed bdag dang nye bar mdzod cig bcom ldan 'das ma khyed bdag dang nye bar mdzod cig thugs kar dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa nas/ kar+m+ma badz+ri'i bar sngar bzhin dang / oṃ badz+ra dhā twi shwa ri ṇi hūm̐ badz+ri ṇi a bhi ṣiñca maṃ nas/ kye rdo rje dbyings kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/

/zhes pa'i bar nyer mchod lnga dang sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod la/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /badz+ra dhā tu aḥbadz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu a/ badz+ro haṃ/ ak+ṣo bh+yo haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥrat+na badz+ro haṃ/ rat+na saṃ bha wo haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥ badz+ra pad+mo ha/ a mi tā bho haṃ/ badz+ra dhā tu aḥ bi shwa badz+ro haṃ/ a mo gha sid+dhi ra haṃ/ satwa badz+ri aḥ badz+ro haṃ/ satwa badz+ri a haṃ/ rat+na badz+ra a/ badz+ra rat+na ma haṃ/ rat+na badz+ri a haṃ/ dhar+m+ma badz+ri aḥ badz+ra pad+mo haṃ/ dharma badz+ri a haṃ/ kar+m+ma badz+ri aḥ bi shwa badz+ro haṃ/ kar+m+ma badz+ri a haṃ/ badz+ra satwa aḥbadz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra satwa haṃ/ badz+ra rā dza aḥ aṃ ku sho haṃ/ badz+ra rā dzo haṃ/ badz+ra rā ga a/ sha ro haṃ/ badz+ra rā go haṃ/ badz+ra sā dhu aḥ tuṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ badz+ra sā dhu ra haṃ/ badz+ra rat+na aḥ rat+na ma haṃ/ badz+ra rat+no haṃ/ badz+ra te dzaḥ.aḥ badz+ra sūr+yo haṃ/ badz+ra te dzo haṃ/ badz+ra ke tu aḥ ke tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra ke tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra ha sa aḥ smi ta ma haṃ/ badz+ra ha so haṃ/ badz+ra dhar+m+ma aḥ pad mo haṃ/ badz+ra dhar+m+mo haṃ/ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa aḥ khaṭa go haṃ/ badz+ra tāṃk+ṣ+ṇo haṃ/ badz+ra he tu aḥ tsakra ma haṃ/ badz+ra he tu ra haṃ/ badz+ra bhā ṣa aḥdzi hwa haṃ/ badz+ra bhā ṣo haṃ/ badz+ra kar+m+ma aḥ kar+m+ma badz+ro haṃ/ badz+ra kar+m+mo haṃ/ badz+ra rak+ṣa aḥ war mo haṃ/ badz+ra rak+ṣo haṃ/ badz+ra yak+ṣa aḥ daṃṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ badz+ra yak+ṣa haṃ/ badz+ra san dhi aḥ muṣ+ṭi ra haṃ/ badz+ra san hi ra haṃ/ badz+ra san dhi ra haṃ/ badz+ra lā s+ye aḥ dwa ya ma haṃ/ badz+ra lā s+ya haṃ/ badz+ra mā le aḥrat+na mā lā haṃ/ badz+ra mā lā haṃ/ badz+ra gī ti aḥ bī nā haṃ/ badz+ra gī t+ya haṃ/ badz+ra nṛ ti aḥbadz+ra nṛ t+ya ka ra pal+la bo haṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+ya haṃ/ badz+ra dhū pe aḥdhū po haṃ/ badz+ra dhū pā haṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥpuṣ+po haṃ/ puṣ+pā haṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke aḥ dī po haṃ/ badz+ra ā lo kā haṃ/ badz+ra gan dhe aḥgan dho haṃ/ badz+ra gan dhā haṃ/ badz+ra aṅku sha aḥ aṃ ku sho haṃ/ badz+ra aṃ ku sho haṃ/

badz+ra pā sha āḥpā sho haṃ/ badz+ra pā sho haṃ/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa aḥs+pho ṭo haṃ/ badz+ra s+pho ṭo haṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ ghaṇ+ṭo haṃ/ badz+ra ā be sho haṃ/ rdo rje bsgrub pa'o/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / nas/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab kyi bar sngar bzhin bya/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐/ badz+ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñca maṃ nas/ kar+m+ma badz+ra ṇi hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ oṃ ṭuṃ/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlab pa sngar bzhin byas la/ oṃ 'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i rig pas byin brlabs pa'i/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar gyi/ /tshig rkang pa dang po dang tha ma gnyis kun la 'gre'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ gyis mchod pa so sor sprul la/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang ba'i ras zung ji skyed kyang / /badz+ra satwa hūm̐ gis dbul ba'i bar rgyal mtshan gyi bar lnga la 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ rin chen bla re yid 'ong rgyan dang ldan/ /chen po'i nyer mchod bde ba sgrub pa yang / /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ lha rdzas las byung sna tshogs mdog dang ldan/ /ba dan yid 'ong phyogs bcur g.yo ba yang / /rgyal ba sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /rgyal ba sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ rin chen rgyal mtshan nor bu'i tog gis spras/ /bdud kyi dgra las rgyal ba'i ba dan 'phyar/ /rgyal ba sogs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ rdo rje me dang / oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ kha dog dbyibs legs dri zhim yid 'ong ba'i/

/me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i shing rnams kyang / /rgyal ba sogs/ puṣ+pe dang / oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje me dang / oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan dhe hūm̐/ bsil zhing yid 'ong reg na gdung ba sel/ /yid 'phrog dri mchog ji snyed yod pa yang / /rgyal ba sogs/ gan dhe dang / oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje me dang / oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ ga pur la sogs legs par sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bdug pa'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa yang / /rgyal ba sogs/ dhū pe dang / oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje me dang / oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ lha rdzas las byung rin chen sgron ma 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa kun tu sel ba yang / /rgyal ba/ ā lo ke dang / oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rdo rje me dang / oṃ dang / ā ka ro dang / kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim ro brgya ldan/ swasti ka sogs zhal zas sna tshogs kyang / rgyal ba/ a kā ro dang / oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ 'di man chad kun la'ang rdo rje me dang / pi wang la sogs rol mo'i khyad par bcu/ /rnar snyan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ khaṃ/ badz+ra hūm̐ ghuṃ/ badz+ra hūm̐ de/ badz+ra hūm̐ twaṃ/ badz+ra trī te/ badz+ra ṭ+wāṃ ṭa/ badz+ra dhā tu/ badz+ra ṭoṃ budhā/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ legs par sbyangs pa'i gar mkhan rol mo ba/ /rab mdzes dga' ba'i rtsed 'jo byed pa kun/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ lha rdzas rin chen las grub cod pan can/ /gdu bu rna rgyan la sogs rgyan mchog kun/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ phyogs rnams kun tu legs par dpyangs pa yi/ /mdzes pa'i dar dpyangs khyad 'phags yod pa kun/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ dri zhim ma l+li ka dang legs spel ba'i/ /me tog rin chen phreng ba mdzes pa yang / /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ rin chen rnga yab dra ba dra phyed dang /

/zla phyed nor bu'i rgyan spras gzhal med khang / /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ bde ba'i gnas su myur ba'i shugs kyis 'gro/ /dgra las rgyal byed cang shes rta yi khyu/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ shin tu stobs ldan rin chen dra bas spras/ /dgra 'joms bzhon pa'i mchog gyur glang chen khyu/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ gnas can rnams kyis 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa'i/ /nyer mchod 'dod 'jo'i ba la sogs pa'i khyu/ /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ rta babs yid 'ong dril bu la sogs pa'i/ /rgyan gyis spras pa phyogs bcur bkod pa yang / /rgyal ba/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ sgeg sogs brgyad dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ oṃ las rin chen sna bdun spyi dang mthun par dbul/ rang byung las ni lus kun gyi/ /'khyud pa'i bde bas mchod pa ni/ /phul nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dra ba de ni myur du 'gyur/ ra ti badz+ra/ shin tu chags pas sbyar ba yi/ /dam du bzung ba'i bde ba ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul gyur na/ /rdo rje rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rā ga badz+ra/ shin tu dga' zhing bde chags pas/ /brtan par gyur pa'i mchog bde ba/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /pra ti badz+ra/ dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar ba'i/ /kun tu sbyor ba'i bde ba ni/ /mchod pa'i phyir ni phul ba na/ /rdo rje las dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /karma badz+ra/ sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag bsdus/ /chos dbyings brtan pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gsang ba kun tu khyab par bsdus/ /mgon po rnam snang mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /gdug pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog mi bskyod pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad nas/ /shar phyogs bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang bskur ma ni rgyal po che/ /nam mkha' thub pa'i skyes mchog ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad nas/

/lho phyogs bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa'i chos 'dzin rgyal po che/ /chos 'dzin gtso bo chen po ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad nas/ /nub phyogs bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa 'dzin rgyal lo/ /don yod grub pa bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brtan mdzad nas/ /byang phyogs bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub spyod pa'i mthu yis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi pha rol phyin/ /de bas pha rol phyin ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsdu ba yi ni dngos po bzhi/ /pha rol phyin pa mchog chen po/ /chos bzhi gcig tu gyur pa yis/ /rdo rje rin chen ma phyag 'tshal/ /gsang ba'i chos kyi ye shes ni/ /de nyid pha rol phyin pa mchog /pha rol phyin pa che las byung / /rdo rje chos ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyor ba yang dag shes pa gang / /rdo rje las mar phyag 'tshal te/ /rgyal mo pha rol phyin bzhi ni/ /rdo rje pha rol phyin mchog la'o/ /sems can thams cad dgrol ba'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la chags pa ste/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsdu ba yi ni dngos po bzhi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang spyad pa/ /sems can dgug pa'i thabs shes pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin phyir bcom ldan gyis/ /gang tshe byang chub spyod pa spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa rjes chags pa/ /rdo rje chags pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byed cing / /legs so zhes bya rab ster byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun mgu byed/ /rdo rje legs pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa gang / /mkha' mnyam rin chen lta bu ste/ /rdo rje rin chen bskal pa che/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rig ling thog 'khor ba yi/ /mi shes mun pa 'joms byed cing / /thar pa'i snang ba gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje gzi brjid phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/

/thar pa'i lam 'gro rgyal mtshan te/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan te/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor chen po rdo rje bzhad/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bzhad byed cing / /byang chub sems dpa' kun dbugs 'byin/ /rdo rje bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor chen po sangs rgyas chos/ /sangs rgyas sems can rtogs byed pa/ /dag pa de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab rnon po ye shes che/ /shin tu sdug pa'i nyon mongs gcod/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang gcod mdzad pa/ /rdo rje rnon po phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo sangs rgyas gar zhes pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu brtan/ /dam chos ro yi bcud las byung / /rdo rje rgyu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos chen po/ /mkha' mtshungs tshig dang bral ba ste/ /tshig med tshig las yang dag byung / /rdo rje smra ba la phyag 'tshal/ /sems can smin dang grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi las gang dang / /sangs rgyas las ni bdag med pa/ /rdo rje las la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsrung ba ste/ /theg pa dman pa spong byed cing / /rtse mo nas lhung srung byed pa/ /rdo rje srung ba phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed cing / /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gcod/ /srid pa za byed gnod sbyin che/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden zhing gzhan min de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur med de kho na nyid gang / /sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid ye shes/ /rdo rje khu tshur phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang phyir rnam par rol pa mchog /sgeg mo sbyin pa'i phar phyin bstod/ /rgyan pa'i lus can yid 'phrog ma/ /phreng ba tshul khrims phar phyin bstod/ /ched du brjod pa ched du brjod/ /glu ma bzod pa'i phar phyin bstod/ /myur du sangs rgyas ster byed pa/ /gar ma brtson 'grus phar phyin bstod/ /'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos pa/ /me tog bsam gtan phar phyin bstod/

/kun tu mtshungs par 'phro ba yi/ /bdug pa shes rab phar phyin bstod/ /phyogs rnams kun tu snang byed pa/ /snang ba smon lam phar phyin bstod/ /dri nga mi dge las phyir phyogs/ /dri ma thabs kyi phar phyin bstod/ /sems can 'gugs pa'i thabs chen po/ /rdo rje lcags kyu phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub spyod pa la spyod pa/ /rdo rje zhags pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa gzhan la'ang 'dod pa med/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams thams cad skye ba med/ /rab tu 'od gsal gzod nas zhi/ /rdo rje theg pa theg chen po/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i chos kyi grong khyer srung / /skal bzang rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag cag sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma rnams bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas la shar du/ na mo badz+ra s+ya di shi di shi badz+ra pā ṇi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā la e h+ye hi bat+ya pa dang / mchod yon phul la/ yang sngags de nyid lan gnyis dang / yang sngags de nyid kyi rjes su badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ badz+ra gan dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha nas/ bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal ba'i bar dang / yang de nyid la na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga te sogs btags pa dang / yang sngags de nyid dang / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams nas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar sngar bzhin dang / yang sngags la puṣ+pe sogs btags nas brjod pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang 'gre bar shes par byas la/ so so'i sngags ni mer/ ag+na ye e h+ye hi ka pi la a ka pi la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ da ha shi khi to li bi ru pak+ṣa swā hā/ lho ru ya mā/ ya swā hā/ bden bral du/ sar+b+ba bhu ta bha yaṃ ka ra ku ru ku ru swā hā/ nub nas/ tri tri pū tra tri tri shi to li bi ru pak+ṣa swā hā/

rlung nas/ oṃ swa sa kha kha khu kha swā hā/ byang nas/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ dbang ldan du/ dz+ruṃ dz+ruṃ shi ba swā hā/ steng du bltas te/ oṃ ur dhaṃ brah+ma ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ sur+yā gra ha a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ 'og tu a dho pri th+wī bh+yaḥswāhā/ a su re bh+yaḥswā hā/ nā ge bh+yaḥswā hā/ ke reg byas/ spos kyi bdug nang du zhugs nas dkyil 'khor la mchod yon dbul/ spos kyis bdug de nas so so'i sngags bzla/ mtshan brgyas bstod pa nas dge ba bsngo ba'i bar sngar bzhin gyis rjes su/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gī shwā ri hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra muḥsar+b+ba saṃ ska ri'i rjes su badz+ra muḥzhes pa'i bar dang / dbang bskur/ go bgo /mnyes par bya ba'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ badz+ra satwa dang yig brgya lan bdun brjod nas/ khyod kyis sems can gyi khams la rjes su brtse bas bka' bstsal zhing / dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs te/ sems can gyi don mdzad na/ so sor skye bo rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pa rnams bskyud nges pa'am yo byad ma tshang ba la sogs pa nyes pa gang cung zad ci mchis pa de dag bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sprul pa'i skus ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs pa la/ bdag nyid byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mi yi nang du babs nas kyang / /sgom phyir sems can kun gyi don/ /rdo rje 'khor lo mchog bskor zhing / /mgon po rab tu bsgrub par mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bos nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ yang gcig tu 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs so/

/de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid du gyur pas mkhyen nas/ phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyang nga'i thugs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rigs dang / dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dang nga'i thugs su zhugs shig de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis snang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /mdor na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /zhugs nas sems can thams cad la/ /phan pa'i phyir ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nas 'di gsungs ma thag tu/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams las/ de bzhin gshegs pa re res kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra mo dang mnyam pa'i sku 'phro ba mdzad pa rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs su zhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku thams cad dang / gsung thams cad 'jug pa'i gnas dang / sems can gyi rgyud 'byung ba thams cad dang rdo rje'i tshul thams cad dang yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang / gnas thams cad dang / mtshan thams cad dang / dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i khung bu thams cad dang / rdul shin tu phra mo ji snyed kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / thugs rnams su zhugs nas bzhugs so/ /de nas a kā ro dang sum bha ni dang / oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsa ne sar+b+ba ar+b+ba swadhā naṃ swā hā/ dkyil 'khor sprul pa thams cad/ bsdus te ri rab kyi rtse mor yongs su btang nas/

'og min gyi gnas su rnam snang longs sku dang dbyer med du gyur te/ de nas dga' ldan gyi gnas su dam pa tog dkar por sprul nas lha rnams la chos ston par mdzad pa las/ shi 'phos nas shākya'i rigs su skye ba bstan te/ dka' ba gcod pa'i mthar thug pa dang / don thams cad 'grub pa'i spyod pa bstan nas/ byang chub kyi shing drung du 'jig rten pa dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir rtswa blangs nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o sems can brtan pa yi/ /sems can don ni bdag don mchog /gang phyir 'dul dbang brtan pa rnams/ /mu stegs lta la gnas par mdzod/ /mdor na mi 'dul 'jig rten pa/ /lta ba ngan pas ldongs pa rnams/ /ye shes snang ba dag bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis 'di skad du/ kye dge slong ci/ byang chub kyi phyir 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal rnams kyi dka' ba bskyed par mdzad dam/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rtswa bting ba la bzhugs nas lha rnams la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /grogs po rnams kho bos byang chub thob par sgrubs shig 'dod pa'i lha rnams kyis don de ma rtogs nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la de ltar gyur pa brjod do/ /brgya byin gyis kyang tshangs pa la brjod do/ /tshangs pas kyang dbang phyug la brjod do/ /dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lha rnams kyi snying po byang chub ga na ba der song ste/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse bar dgongs te rang gi gdan 'di las bzhengs te/ lha rdzas kyi gdan la bzhugs nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po de dag la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /grogs po rnams kho bos bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sbyin par sgrubs shig

de nas de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis byang chub stsol bar mi nus so/ /ci te bdag cag gis nus par gyur na/ da lta bdag nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de nyid gsal bar mdzad cing yang tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /'di ni gzugs min gzugs med min/ /bden min brdzun min gtsang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ /rtogs na rgyal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas lha'i dbang po de dag gis byang chub pa'i don mngon sum du byas shing bcom ldan 'das rtswa'i gdan las bzhengs te/ lha rnams la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /grogs po rnams sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'di lta bu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir sgrubs shig de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rngo mi thog lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdan de la bzhugs bzhin du/ yid kyis rab tu rtogs pa na/ /byang chub sems ni brtan par byos/ /sems dpa'i rdo rje brtan byas la/ /sangs rgyas su ni bdag sgoms shig /ces gsungs so/ /de dag gis de lta bu legs so zhes smras nas/ rang rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan mo de'i tho rangs 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir/ bdud pham par byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mngon par sangs rgyas nas phyag na rdo rje rang gi thugs la zhugs pa la/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dis mngon par brjod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /theg pa chen po'i bdag nyid che/ /snang ba che zhing dag pa che/ /gtso chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyal po rdo rje che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus che/ /thabs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dod pa dga' ba che/ /kun gyi bde ba bde ba che/ /bde mchog thog ma tha ma med/

/bzhad chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje legs pa dgyes pa che/ /legs zhes bya bas rab bzhad pa/ /bzhad pa che zhing dgyes pa che/ /rab dgyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rin chen rgyal po che/ /rang gi dbang bskur dbang che ba/ /rin chen thams cad mdzes pa che/ /rnam rgyan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gzi brjid gzi brjid che/ /'od chen lham pa chen po ste/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba che/ /sangs rgyas 'od chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan rgyal mtshan che/ /rgyal mtshan che bas nor rab stong / /nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan yu ba che/ /stong pa'i rgyal mtshan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje bzhad pa bzhad pa che/ /dgyes pa che zhing rab dgyes pa/ /dgyes pa'i shugs kyi rol zhing dgyes/ /chos dgyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje chos ni chos che ba/ /sems dpa'i chos ni chos rab sbyong / /sangs rgyas chos te chos rab mchog /'dod chos khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnon po ral gri che/ /shes rab ye shes blo gros che/ /sdig gcod ral gri chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas mtshon khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rgyu ste 'khor lo che/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo gter chen po/ /dkyil 'khor kun te chos kyi mchog /chos kyi 'khor lo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gsung ba gsung ba che/ /spros med yi ge chen po ste/ /yi ge med pa bzlas pa che/ /sangs rgyas gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje las te las mchog pa/ /las chen las rab byed pa ste/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa mchod pa che/ /sangs rgyas mchod khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje srung ba go cha che/ /go cha'i mchog ste bstan pa che/ /srung ba che zhing snying po che/ /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo che/ /ma rung thams cad skrag byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs che ba/ /srung mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bsdams pa phyag rgya che/

/dam tshig chen po 'ching ba po/ /bsdams pa chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /rdo rje bsdams pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /de bzhin gshegs pas phyag bya zhing / /brjod de mchod cing bsti stangs byas/ /gang zhig thog ma tha ma med/ /byang chub sems ni khyod yin te/ /khyod la brten nas rgyal ba dang / /dpa' bo byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /byung zhing yang dag 'byung 'gyur bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje chos khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje las ni khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag par ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /mtshan mchog gis ni khyod bstod pa'i/ /bsod nams gang yin de kun yang / /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par shog /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'di/ /rab dad pas ni lan gcig can/ /gang gis legs par brjod na ni/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus te gsung gcig tu legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /theg pa chen po mngon 'dus pa'i/ /mdo sde legs par bshad pas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod legs so/ /rdo rje rin chen khyod legs so/ /rdo rje chos ni khyod legs so/ /rdo rje las ni khyod legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa rang gi thugs la zhugs pa thams cad dgyes shing mnyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' gsungs pa la mngon par dgyes par gyur to/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra san dhi baṃ/ badz+ra satwa/ dpal ldan rnal 'byor rgyud chen gyi/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i dbyings/ /bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga yi/
